澳洲 IRP 与可靠性标准：IRP 补“2024-06-03 起实施”；2028–2032 可靠性标准 99.997% 由“草案”改为 Reliability Panel 2026-04 最终报告建议值；AEMC IESS/IRP 规则页挂为可点击链接。
澳德储能模块：WDRM 直接参与门槛由“约 1 MW”改为“MW 级（以 AER 指南为准）”；§14a 由“4.2 kW 门槛”改为“>4.2 kW 功率门槛（低压并网）”；灵活出口范围去掉未证实的昆士兰，改为“南澳、维多利亚等州 DNSP”；容量市场、AgNes 时间表与来源表同步上述更正，AEMC 与 BNetzA 官方链接改为可点击。
其他核实：删除德国容量拍卖表中无法核实的“€244k/MW/年”结果列，改为“结果以招标公告为准”；EEG 2027 修正案草案去掉未证实的“2026-07”月份；CIS 第 9、10 轮结果在观察清单标为“待公布”。
技能与文档：储能投资与运营技能中英两版同步 AgNes 时间表、IRP 实施日、§14a “>4.2 kW”与容量市场储能资格；README / INDEX_EN 无重复错误口径；正文行数由 18,908 增至 18,914，模块数 49、Markdown 72 个不变。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：新增澳洲 NEM、德国电力市场与澳德储能业务三个海外模块
items: 新增分区与结构：scripts/knowledge.config.mjs 在「电力现货与省间交易」之后插入 intl 分区（06 / GLOBAL，导航名「海外市场」），其后 8 个分区编号顺延为 07 / PRICE 至 14 / RESEARCH，「使用与口径」改为 15 / METHOD；分区数 10→11、模块 46→49、正文 16,745→18,908 行。首页二级知识地图补「澳大利亚 NEM」「德国电力市场」「澳德储能业务」三个 chip，问题句改为「现货如何出清、如何结算，国内外市场怎么衔接」；专题图谱增至 8 条，新增「澳 / 德市场与储能设计对照」。

澳大利亚 NEM：新增澳大利亚 NEM 电力市场（m-intl-au，intl 分区第 1 篇，713 行正文）。覆盖五个区域（昆士兰、新南威尔士、维多利亚、南澳、塔斯马尼亚；西澳 WEM 与北领地不在内）、AEMO / AEMC / AER 分工、能源-only + FCAS 共同优化、2021-10-01 起的 5 分钟出清与结算、NEM 固定 AEST、2026-27 价格带（MPC A$23,200/MWh、CPT A$2,225,900/MWh、APC A$600/MWh、MFP −A$1,000/MWh、AFP −A$600/MWh）、MLF/IRLF 与结算残差、RRO/RERT/CIS、LGC/SRES 与 IRP 储能注册（IESS 为规则改革名称，不是注册类别）、ASX 合约与 PPA、中国主体注册与保函路径、十个坑与中澳对照，附合成算例（D 级）。

德国：新增德国电力市场（m-intl-de，intl 分区第 2 篇，716 行正文）。覆盖 DE-LU 报价区与欧盟耦合、EPEX 日前 12:00 CET 关门与 pay-as-clear、日内 pay-as-bid、2025-10-01 起的 15 分钟 MTU、SDAC −€500/MWh 与 SIDC −€9,999/MWh 两个地板不可混用、FCR/aFRR/mFRR 容量与能量分开及 PICASSO/MARI、Redispatch 2.0（2021-10-01 起，≥100 kW）、EEG §51 负价归零与 §60 已废止、§14a 可控负荷、AgNes 电网费改革（2026-10 决定草案、2027-01-01 最终决定、2029 年起适用）、StromVKG 容量机制（2031 起，2026-09-02 获欧盟批准）、中国主体进入路径、十个坑与中德对照，附合成算例（D 级）。

澳德储能业务：新增澳德储能业务：大储与工商储（m-intl-storage，intl 分区第 3 篇，682 行正文）。按澳洲大储、澳洲工商储、德国大储、德国工商储四个象限组织：澳洲大储覆盖套利 + FCAS + CIS、IRP/Generator/Market Customer 注册、NSP 连接与 MASS 测试；澳洲工商储覆盖需量电费、分时价差、CSIP-AUS 灵活出口与 WDRM/VPP 聚合；德国大储覆盖 EPEX 15 分钟 MTU、FCR/aFRR/mFRR、§118(6) 20 年电网费豁免（2029-08-04 前投运）、AgNes 2029 改革与 StromVKG 2031 容量机制；德国工商储覆盖需量电费、§14a 三模块、动态电价与聚合。另含投决输入契约、收入堆叠的功率/能量/时间占用、四个合成算例（D 级）、十个坑、中澳/中德对照与 2026 观察清单；来源表区分官方原文、行业媒体与未挂链接项。

技能接入：电力交易技能中英两版在 §7 后新增「7A. 海外市场速查（澳大利亚 NEM / 德国）」，含市场卡片表、NEM 五要点与公式、德国六要点与公式、同题对照表与答题纪律；§0.3 知识地图补一行，§15.4 限制条件注明只覆盖 NEM 与 DE-LU，不含 WEM、北领地及欧洲其他国家。储能投资与运营技能中英两版在 §14 后新增「14A. 海外市场速查（澳洲 NEM / 德国 DE-LU）」，含四象限市场卡片、澳洲五条、德国六条、同题对照与六条答题纪律；§0.3 知识地图、维护入口、来源与维护节奏同步补海外项。不新增第十个技能，避免与电力交易、储能主技能重复。
配色与图谱：新增低饱和靛蓝强调色（浅色 #43548f / #e8ebf6，深色 #a3b2e8 / #1c2440），首页 data-cat="intl" 与阅读页 body[data-cat="intl"] 同步；第八块专题图谱用 5 步流程、三条 mini 卡（第三条为「储能四象限」）与四个事实块对照两国设计，图注说明两国不是同一套规则的两个版本、储能收益结构差异更大。

文档与口径：README / README_EN、INDEX_EN、本文件、更新清单 同步为 49 个模块 / 18,908 行正文 / 72 个 Markdown（49 个知识模块 + 18 个技能文件 + 5 个仓库级文档）；英文索引补三行模块地图、海外关键数字表与第 22 条未定事项。三个模块的 cutoff 均为 2026-11-01，价格带与规则均写明时点与适用范围；算例为合成数据（D 级），不作为投资建议。
移动端锚点：带 #分区 直达时，页面原本带着平滑滚动从顶部滚约 1.5 秒才落位，且字体加载后激活项可能停在上一个分区；现改为首屏锚点瞬时落位、落位后再恢复平滑滚动，粘性偏移重算时同步刷新激活项，并在每次激活计算时校正导航横向位置，使「06 海外市场」等 active 胶囊完整可见。点击导航的平滑滚动保持不变。
校验：构建、--check 与一致性检查通过；重建 49 个知识页 + 18 个技能页 + 18 个 TXT；新增外链逐条实测后保留官方页面，AEMO/AEMC/AER/regelleistung 等站点对自动访问有拦截、正文已标注未挂链接，仅保留实测可访问的 EnWG §14a 与 §118(6) 链接；桌面与移动端截图核对新分区、卡片、专题图谱与三份阅读页。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：知识库界面与交互全面修复
items: 筛选、锚点与空状态：首页筛选后隐藏卡片里的目录锚点不再跳到空处——点击站内锚点会先清空筛选再定位；无结果时给出"清除筛选"按钮并说明原因；筛选与搜索写入 ?q=&type=，刷新或分享链接可恢复原视图。搜索改为 150ms 防抖，新增一键清除（桌面 32px、移动端 40px），高亮用 TreeWalker 只处理文本节点，Escape 清空输入，结果计数通过 aria-live 播报，筛选按钮补 aria-pressed。

移动端粘性遮挡：侧栏高度写入 --hub-header，筛选条与锚点偏移合成为 --hub-scroll-offset（侧栏 + 筛选条 + 16px），在 resize、字体加载与 ResizeObserver 触发时重算；html{scroll-padding-top} 统一接管锚点落位。阅读页删掉标题上叠了两层的 scroll-margin-top，只保留 --topbar-h + 18px。
整卡可点：模块卡片标题链接用 stretched-link 覆盖整卡，每卡只保留一个 Tab 停靠点；覆盖层加 z-index:1，卡片底部同样可点，键盘聚焦时显示卡片级焦点环。
移动筛选条与点击目标：≤760px 隐藏筛选按钮、改用原生 select，结果计数视觉隐藏但保留 aria-live；首页导航、按钮、清除键与阅读页返回、目录、来源、主题、政策 chips 的点击高度统一到 40–44px；回到顶部由 34px 提到 44px 并在移动端保留。
阅读页抽屉：打开目录时锁定背景滚动并对 .main/.toc 设 inert；Tab 在抽屉内循环，Esc、点击遮罩或任一条目关闭并把焦点还给触发按钮，视口回到 ≥901px 时自动关闭。

对比度与字号：琥珀 #8a5410、绿 #37703f、青 #0d6a63、VPP #8a5a12、slate #5a6470 替换偏浅的强调色；控件描边提深到 #7f8a91（深色 #66737e）满足 3:1，文字配对在浅色与深色下均通过 WCAG AA。新增 --fs-read:15.5px 作为阅读页正文与引言字号，原先 10–13.8px 的十余个散值收敛到 --fs-2xs 至 --fs-lg 七档；白底卡片改用 --card-line 描边与 --shadow-card 与画布分层；正文行宽由 43rem 收到 39rem。
侧栏说明：左下角"阅读原则"从贴底的一行 11px 小字改为带描边圆角的浅灰说明卡——等宽小标题配短线，三条原则分行加点标记，字号提到 12.5px；≤820px 高的桌面视口同步收紧导航行距与卡片内边距，1366×768 下 15 个分区无需滚动即可看全。

代码与生成物：新增 knowledge/assets/tokens.css 集中颜色、字体与字号令牌，首页构建时内联、阅读页通过 <link> 引入，删除两处重复的深浅主题令牌；移除表格首列强制不换行，移动端改为 min-width:6.5em 并保留横向滚动；补 prefers-reduced-motion；删除 IntersectionObserver 中无用的 visible 映射；进度条实时更新 aria-valuenow；模块卡片 CTA 由 ↗ 改为"进入模块 →"（政策外链保留 ↗）；首页不再输出"XX 行"内部元数据；≤1180px 的 hero 面板由隐藏改为两列紧凑展示。
校验：46 个模块 / 16,745 行 / 69 个 Markdown 与生成物计数不变；构建、--check 与一致性检查通过；在 390×844 移动视口与桌面浅/深色下截图核对，并用脚本实测筛选、锚点偏移、搜索防抖/高亮/URL 恢复、整卡点击、抽屉焦点陷阱、进度语义与对比度矩阵。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：浅色主题改为纯白底
items: 浅色主题换白底：知识中心与阅读页的浅色 token 由纸黄改为纯白——--paper 由 #f6f2e9 改为 #fff，--card 由 #fffdf8 改为 #fff；辅助底色 --paper-2 由 #efe9dc 改为中性浅灰 #f4f6f7，继续用于标签、计数与表头等需要一层浅色区分的元素。墨色字、青/琥珀/蓝/红/紫强调色与深色主题均不变。
分隔线去暖：--line 由 #ddd5c6 改为 #e2e6e9，--line-strong 由 #c8bda9 改为 #c8d0d6，白底上不再出现米黄色描边。
半透明与条纹：首页固定筛选条、移动端侧栏的半透明底由暖色 rgba(246,242,233,.96/.95) 改为白色，滚动渐隐遮罩同步；阅读页表格偶数行由暖色 50% 改为 rgba(22,35,47,.035) 的中性浅灰；打印配色同步为白底与中性分隔线。
一处改动全站生效：知识中心来自 knowledge/index.template.html，46 个知识页与 18 个技能页共用 knowledge/assets/knowledge.css；重建后 index.html 更新，其余页面只换样式表。
校验：46 个模块 / 16,745 行 / 69 个 Markdown 与生成物计数不变；构建、--check 与一致性检查通过；首页按桌面与 500px 移动宽度、阅读页按浅色与深色分别截图核对，深色主题样式未受影响。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：标识改为双色——浅青书页 + 墨绿闪电
items: 双色标识：knowledge/assets/logo-book.svg 由单色负形改为两段路径——书页实填浅青 #dcefe9，外加 3.2 宽、35% 透明的墨绿描边勾勒书脊与书页；闪电改为实心墨绿 #0e6b66，不再从书页中挖空。浅色底上书页退为淡色块、闪电保持主体；深色底上浅青书页与墨绿闪电对比充分。
取消深色版：双色标识本身不分主题，删除 knowledge/assets/logo-book-dark.svg，knowledge/assets/ 回到 3 个 SVG（主标、单色、favicon）；单色版与 favicon 未改。
侧栏同款：knowledge/index.template.html 的 22px 侧栏标识改为内联双色版，不再走 currentColor；深色主题下靠浅青书页与墨绿描边保证可见性，布局与字号不变。
README 首屏：README / README_EN 从 <picture> 深浅切换改回单张居中 <img>（宽 96，指向主标），目录树同步为"阅读页样式与脚本 + 标识（3 个 SVG）"。
小尺寸取舍：favicon 保持单色墨绿 + 加粗闪电，并在 SVG 内按 prefers-color-scheme 切到 #6cc8ba——双色书页在 16px 下浅青部分会糊成一团，单色更稳；22px 侧栏从书页与闪电两处仍可认出标识。
计数与校验：46 个模块 / 16,745 行 / 69 个 Markdown 与生成物计数不变；构建、--check 与一致性检查通过；首页在浅色与深色下截图核对，README 首屏按 96 / 44 / 22 / 16px 四档核对。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：知识库标识"书页电光"与全站 SVG favicon
items: 标识定稿：采用"书页电光"——一本摊开的书，中缝处留出一道闪电形负形。主体为单条 path 配合 fill-rule="evenodd" 挖空，不依赖 mask，可直接压在任何底色上；主色沿用站点青 #0e6b66，深色场景用 #6cc8ba。
四个 SVG 资产：knowledge/assets/logo-book.svg 为主标（固定青）；logo-book-dark.svg 为深色版（#6cc8ba）；logo-book-mono.svg 把填充改为 currentColor，供内联与单色使用；logo-book-favicon.svg 为小尺寸版，闪电加粗并在 SVG 内用 prefers-color-scheme 深浅切换。
首页侧栏：knowledge/index.template.html 原先 9px 的方块点改为 22px 书页图标 + "Energy Skills" 字样，图标走 currentColor 随主题变色；移动端标签字号收到 9.5px。
favicon：知识中心首页与 64 个生成页（46 个知识页 + 18 个技能页）在 <head> 接入 SVG favicon；技能页与知识页由 scripts/build-knowledge-html.mjs 统一注入 ../assets/ 路径。
仓库首页：README / README_EN 顶部加居中标识，用 <picture> 按 prefers-color-scheme 切换深浅版；标题去掉原有的 ⚡ 以免与标识重复；目录树补 knowledge/assets/ 一行。
计数与校验：46 个模块 / 16,745 行 / 69 个 Markdown 与生成物计数不变；构建、--check 与一致性检查通过；侧栏标识在深浅主题下均取主题色，favicon 的加粗闪电在 16px 下仍可辨认。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：技能卡片接入 HTML 阅读页并支持 TXT 下载
items: 技能阅读页：知识中心首页的 9 个技能入口（顶部 chips 与底部卡片）不再跳转 skills/*/SKILL.md 原始 Markdown，改为 18 个生成式阅读页——每个技能中英各一页（skill-<slug>.html / skill-<slug>-en.html），由 scripts/build-knowledge-html.mjs 读取 SKILL.md / SKILL_EN.md 正文生成，与知识模块共用同一套版式、侧栏与深浅主题。
不改技能文件：两份 SKILL 的 frontmatter 仍只有 name 与 description，技能目录可直接安装；标题、摘要、标签与顺序由 scripts/knowledge.config.mjs 新增的 skillDocs（9 项）提供，构建时校验其数量与 site.skills 一致。
链接重写：技能页内指向知识模块的 ../../knowledge/*.md 改写为同目录 *.html；技能之间的 ../<slug>/SKILL.md 改写为对应技能阅读页；SKILL_EN.md 指向该技能英文页；页头提供 English / 中文 切换，另保留"查看原文"指向仓库中的 Markdown。
TXT 下载：每个技能页新增"下载 TXT"按钮，内容为该技能完整 Markdown（含 frontmatter），共 18 个文件输出到 knowledge/html/download/skills/skill-<slug>[-en].txt（下载文件名形如 电力交易专家-SKILL.txt）；英文页按钮与提示文案同步为英文。
导航与校验：侧栏新增"配套技能"分区（15 / SKILLS，仅列中文页，英文页经语言切换进入），技能页的上一页/下一页只在技能目录内循环；--check 在 46 个知识页之外，另校验 18 个技能页与 18 个 TXT 是否为最新、是否残留无对应源的旧文件。
首页与文档：knowledge/index.template.html 的 chips 与卡片改指 html/skill-*.html，技能区加 id="skills"，说明文字改为"每个技能都有 HTML 阅读页与 TXT 下载"；README / README_EN 的"直接阅读"与目录树同步为 46 个知识页 + 18 个技能页与 download/skills/ 下 18 个 TXT。
计数不变：46 个模块 / 16,745 行 / 69 个 Markdown 不变；生成物为 46 个知识阅读页 + 18 个技能阅读页 + 18 个 TXT。构建、--check 与一致性检查通过，英文页下载按钮与语言切换已在浏览器实测。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：补齐储能、电价与 VPP 三个核心模块
items: 储能投资与运营补齐投决层：储能投资与运营第 4 章扩为"参数、算例与敏感性"，新增 100 MW/200 MWh 全量投决算例（CAPEX 20,000 万元、年收入 3,656.9 万元、税后现金流 2,701.0 万元、NPV@8% 3,119.4 万元、IRR 10.47%、回收期 7.40 年、LCOS 742.24/458.15 元/MWh、DSCR 1.53），另加收入堆叠与三维占用、退化/质保/增容的现金流处理、O&M 与消防并网合规成本（0.3 MW 辅电年 131 万元）、10 情景敏感性，以及 5 MW/10 MWh 与 20 MW/40 MWh 两个对照算例；所有数字与储能技能一致。

电价与查证补电费单计算链：中国电价现行政策与查证第 4 章扩为"科目、计算链与算例"，新增电费总公式与科目表、代理购电价格组成与月度测算链、两部制三方式算例（1,600 kVA/1,150 kW，105% 超需与 40% 下限，闭式最优申报 D* = max(40% 下限, A÷1.05)，按月优化省 128,975.24 元）、力调电费（131,600 元基数，3,684.80 元差额；简化两档规则明确标注为演示）、基金附加与系统运行费、171,600 元完整账单与七参数省级差异矩阵；常见错误扩到 16 条。

新增 VPP 核心模块：虚拟电厂：聚合、调度与商业模式（m-vpp-core，vpp 分区第 1 篇，758 行正文）。覆盖资源盘点与 A–D 分类、能力测算（12.25 MW 理论合计按同时率 0.8 与可用率 0.95 折算 9.31 MW）、准入接入七步与 12 省门槛表、云边控制与数据链路、市场参与与收益堆叠、10 MW/20 MWh 聚合调度算例、CBL 与结算分成、六类商业模式与园区 VPP 测算（NPV 689.9 万元、IRR 约 18.0%、回收期 4.49 年）、省级地图、12 步落地清单、10 类失败模式与 15 条常见错误；明确四类容量口径与"国家 VPP 管理办法尚未出台"。

碳资产补履约成本算例：碳资产实务新增 §3.1“配额缺口 + CCER 5% + CBAM”：排放 100 万 t、免费配额 92 万 t、缺口 8 万 t；CCER 用满 5%（5 万 t × 86.51）+ CEA 补足（3 万 t × 94.94）= 717.37 万元，单位缺口成本 89.67 元/t，并给出"CCER 盈亏平衡价 = CEA 价"的决策规则；另附出口钢材 CBAM 算例（1 万 t × 0.60 tCO2/t × 75.28 欧元 = 45.17 万欧元）与"国内履约 / CBAM 两套账"边界，所有金额标注 D 级。

通识 A/D 年度数据刷新：电力系统通识 A新增 §3.5"2026 年格局快照"（装机 41.3 亿 kW、风光 20.1 亿 kW/48.7%、光伏 12.86 亿于 2026-07 首超煤电 12.85 亿、注册主体 109 万家、现货至少 11 省 + 南方区域）；电力系统通识 D更新 §1 的电源/主体/成本口径，补 2025 年底新型储能 1.36 亿 kW、2026 年 1-9 月利用小时 915 h、VPP 470 个项目/1,685 万 kW，并把 357 号文日期修正为 2025-04-11、纠正"风光装机占比过半"的表述。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：新增 SCADA 与电力监控数据链路知识模块
items: 新增模块：SCADA 与电力监控数据链路（m-scada，storage 分区第 5 篇，1,183 行正文）。定位 VPP/EMS 的数据底座，不写调度算法：开篇给出"现场设备层 → 站控/边缘网关 → 生产控制区 SCADA → 安全接入区 → 管理信息区 VPP/EMS"的分层架构图，并用控制指令闭环图说明"下发—鉴权—互锁—执行—回读—审计"。
点表与四遥：对象模型、点表最小字段集、变比/量纲/死区、质量码、双点遥信中间态、点表核对清单；明确遥控/遥调的选择-执行、超时、回执与回读。
边缘与云端两种部署形态：明确 SCADA 是功能定义而非按位置分类，工程上分边缘侧（站控/设备侧，低时延、断网自治、控制执行）与云端（云化监控平台，跨站监视、长期历史、分析运维）两节；附职责/时延/数据保留/安全分区对比表、云边协同三条铁律，并澄清"云 SCADA"不是标准术语、集控中心承担生产控制时仍须落在生产控制区。
部署工程细化：边缘侧补充软硬件组成、站内双网/环网与共因故障、边缘计算边界、历史与补数容量估算、七类反模式、六项验收演练；云端补充参考分层、接入与数据治理约定、多租户权限、SLA 与合同条款、存储成本估算、七类反模式、五类场景选型与六项故障演练。
协议与链路：IEC 60870-5-104（TCP 2404、ASDU、k/w、t0–t3、CP56Time2a）、IEC 61850（MMS/GOOSE/SV、SCL、控制模型）、Modbus（RTU/TCP 502、寄存器、无时标/质量/认证）、MQTT（QoS、retained、LWT、TLS、应用层确认）、OPC UA/DL/T 476/CIM 的边界；另列协议网关五个坑。
时延、对时与数据治理：采样/上报/存储三种周期、P50/P95/P99 时延合同写法、北斗/GPS/PTP/IRIG-B/NTP 的精度与适用、UTC/本地时区与 CP56Time2a 的差异、完整率/正确率/及时率/可用率、补数缓存估算、历史库压缩与保留、数据血缘。
告警、冗余与安全：告警分级与风暴抑制、告警生命周期、冗余层级与共因故障、切换演练；按 2024 年第 27 号令（2025-01-01 施行，替代 2014 年第 14 号令）写安全分区、生产控制区/管理信息区/安全接入区、横向隔离与纵向认证、VPP 云边控制边界、等保与关基要求、上线安全清单。
接口与验收：SCADA 与 EMS/VPP 的数据契约、控制契约、SCADA 与结算计量的边界（SCADA 不能替代关口表）、对账步骤、联调用例、P0/P1 验收清单、15 条常见故障与误区、标准文件表与术语表。

链接与联动：NDRC 27号令页面/PDF、NEA 答记者问、GB/T 36572-2018、IEC 60870-5-104、IEC 61850-8-1、Modbus、MQTT、OPC UA、NIST SP 800-82 Rev.3 等链接逐一实测；knowledge.config.mjs 的 storage 分区描述与覆盖范围、两份 EMS 底稿的 related 与正文指针、README / README_EN、INDEX_EN、更新清单 同步为 45 个模块 / 15,512 行 / 68 个 Markdown；构建与一致性检查通过。

entries.label: v1.9 维护：两个新技能的口径复核与补强
items: 修正报价口径：售电零售 §10.1 原先只写"最低报价 0.46025"，把目标利润包进了保本口径。拆为保本报价 0.45025（批发 0.41725 + 偏差 0.00800 + 运营 0.02500）与目标报价 0.46025（+0.01000 目标利润）；按 0.46 签约比保本报价高 0.975 分、比目标报价低 0.025 分，安全垫很薄。v1.9 条目同步改正。
拆分保本公式与风险安全线：§4.3 原式把风险溢价 R 从保本利润中扣掉，得不出"利润为零"的保本价。改为现金保本 S* = (P − D − O − F − cL)/(1 − c)，另列安全线 S*_R（再扣 R，用于内部限价与授信），并说明 R 是缓冲、不是已发生成本。
偏差公式量纲修正：§6.2 原式 2σφ(t/σ) 的输入是比例、输出也是比例，与"超带电量（kWh）"对不上。改为 σ_F = σ × F、t_F = t × F，期望 2σ_Fφ(t_F/σ_F) = 2σFφ(t/σ)，95% 分位 max((zσ − t)F, 0)。
补全成本项：§5.1 客户贡献与 §5.2 组合净利补入担保资金成本 F；§7.1 批零倒挂定义改为"零售合同价格低于全成本（批发采购 + 偏差 + 运营 + 担保资金成本）"；新增 §4.6 报价口径清单（含税/不含税、线损、偏差、绿电绿证、容量/需量、调整机制）。
修正联动套餐下限算例：§10.8 原写"下限 0.40 只能保证售价不低于 0.41"，但 0.41 已高于 0.40，下限并未触发。改为：0.40 是零售价下限，公式价 0.41 时不触发；补 70/30 加权采购成本列，说明低价行假设长协也在 0.40；保本零售价 0.433，若下限作用在现货价，需从 P = αS + a ≥ 0.433 反解。
用户侧技能补口径：新增线损与含税口径（线损一般在输配电价内回收，不重复加收）；§6.1 力率 0.5%/0.15% 明示为演示比例、非省级标准；§3.6/§9.1 补"时限、40% 下限、双路进线以本省实施细则为准"；§7.4 统一为"批零倒挂"并交叉引用售电技能 §7–§9；§10.1 复算清单补线损与含税两项。
工具与回归不变：测算工具未改，所有数字仍由 tools/*.py 复算；七个带工具技能的自测全部通过，build-knowledge-html.mjs --check 与 check-consistency.mjs 通过（44 个模块 / 14,326 行、67 个 Markdown 文件）。

entries.label: v1.9：新增售电零售与风险技能与零依赖测算工具
items: 新增第九技能：售电零售与风险（retail-electricity-risk），中英双语。站在售电公司一侧，回答"套餐怎么定、客户怎么选、批发怎么配、偏差怎么控、批零倒挂怎么防、保函和退出怎么兜"；覆盖五类套餐、全成本定价、客户贡献、购电覆盖、偏差期望与分位、履约保障、信用 A–D、结算 5/8/10、退出与保底售电。第 1 章写明与电力交易、量化报价、电价与电费优化、VPP、储能的分工。

零依赖工具：tools/package.py 固定价与市场联动报价、单客户年度结果与保本现货价；tools/portfolio.py 组合净利、客户贡献、现货压力与保本倍数；tools/deviation.py 超带电量、期望 2σφ(t/σ) 与 95% 分位；tools/guarantee.py 现行/草案保函、资金成本与缺口；tools/curves.py 合成客户曲线、现货曲线与分时价格。
自测：tools/selftest.py A–H 八组、63 条断言，覆盖解析式手算、压力情景、分位模型、保函口径、缺口与确定性；CI 增加该自测，七个带工具的技能共七步自测。
联动：README / README_EN、知识中心"九项配套技能"、scripts/knowledge.config.mjs 技能计数、scripts/check-consistency.mjs 的中英数字对照（新增 47 条）与 更新清单.md 技能联动表同步为九个技能；全部技能版本头升至 v1.9。

entries.label: v1.8：新增用户侧电价与电费优化技能与零依赖测算工具
items: 新增第八技能：用户侧电价与电费优化（tariff-bill-optimization），中英双语。回答"电费单贵在哪、基本电费选容量还是需量、申报值定多少、零售套餐怎么比"；覆盖两部制、105% 超需、40% 下限、分时与尖峰、力率考核、基金附加、代理购电与市场联动套餐。边界写明：只回答选价、申报与账单复核，逐时段充放交给 EMS。
零依赖工具：tools/bill.py 拆科目与三种基本电费、tools/demand.py 闭式最优申报 D* = max(40% 下限, A/1.05)、tools/tariff.py 校验时段表并做负荷平移、tools/retail.py 比价固定价/分时/市场联动、tools/curves.py 生成 D 级合成负荷与价格。
自测：tools/selftest.py A–H 八组、51 条断言，覆盖科目复算、闭式申报、年度优化、力率、时段校验、平移与套餐情景；CI 增加该自测，六个带工具的技能共六步自测。
联动：README / README_EN、知识中心"八项配套技能"、scripts/knowledge.config.mjs 技能计数、scripts/check-consistency.mjs 的中英数字对照（新增 34 条）与 更新清单.md 技能联动表同步为八个技能。

entries.label: v1.7：新增 EMS 优化调度技能与零依赖调度内核
items: 新增第七技能：EMS 优化调度（ems-dispatch），中英双语。覆盖逐时段调度建模、PCC 与 BMS 可达能力、需量与容量、备用与可交付性、退化成本、MPC 滚动与孤岛切换；SKILL.md 第 1 章写明为何独立成技能而不并入 VPP——对象是调度而非聚合、方法是优化而非规则、储能技能已把调度交给算法底稿、VPP 侧只有技术栈示意。

零依赖内核：tools/dispatch.py 用前向动态规划在统一 SOC 网格上解单电池 LP，充放互斥由构造保证，进出线按净负荷符号拆开，支持 PV 弃电、PCC 上下限、备用功率与能量裕度、循环/自由终端 SOC。配套 storage.py（AC 侧电量、单向效率、调频与需量）、market.py（容量补偿、调频里程、需量表）、microgrid.py（微网封装与孤岛能量核算）、curves.py（合成曲线）。

算例对齐：两份算法底稿第 9 章的算例全部换成工具输出，并回填到技能正文。储能站谷充峰放净收益 91,352.24 元/年、容量补偿 15,068.49 元/年、合计 106,420.74；用户侧 8,414.11 元/天（能量 4,414.11 + 需量日摊 4,000）；共用 PCC 14,148 / 9,648 元/年；可达能力 418.95 kW / 735.00 kWh / 1.7544 h；微网基线 7,408.72 元/天、优化后 6,525.12（−883.59，−11.93%），峰荷 878.54 → 838.50 kW。
敏感性成组：微网篇第 9.4 节新增退化、容量 +20%、900 kW 进线、PV +20% 配 500 kW 上网、备用能量强制五组对照（6,617.72 / 6,350.61 / 6,519.97 / 5,996.19 / 6,663.52），并量化备用功率够而能量差 52.63 kWh、需量上限 840 kW 每日多花 5.15 元但每月省 3,082.99 元。
自测：tools/selftest.py 扩到 A–I 九组、82 条断言，覆盖解析式手算、调度可行性、孤岛切换、确定性与上述敏感性数值；CI 增加该自测，五个带工具的技能共五步自测。
联动：README / README_EN、知识中心“七项配套技能”、scripts/knowledge.config.mjs 技能计数、scripts/check-consistency.mjs 的中英数字对照（新增 36 条）与 更新清单.md 技能联动表同步为七个技能。

items: 背景：知识中心的卡片行数、模块数、分类计数与搜索词此前手写在 knowledge/index.html，新增模块后曾出现旧计数残留（38 个模块 / 10,837 行、41/27 等）。手维护清单与正文天然会漂移。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：电力市场风险、信用与结算知识模块 + HTML 阅读页
items: 新增知识笔记：电力市场风险、信用与结算-2026-11。定位是制度层，回答"风险怎么分、信用怎么评、保函交多少、偏差怎么罚、结算怎么走、售电公司倒下后用户怎么办"；预测报价与 VaR/CVaR 归量化报价笔记，市场品种与交易策略归电力交易技能，项目经济性归储能技能，VPP 聚合归 VPP 技能，不重复写一套工程实现。

风险与信用：2026-09-30 风险防控草案为 7 章 32 条，内部 5 类（不正当竞争、合同违约、价格异常、机制、其他）加外部 3 类（供需失衡、技术支持系统异常、舆情），按重大/一般 × 紧急/非紧急分级；2026-10 信用评价草案设 A (85,100]、B (70,85]、C (40,70]、D [0,40] 或严重失信，季度评价 + 动态调整，C/D 级提高保障额度且增量不得用保险。
履约保障与偏差：现行 1595 号按"12 个月批发购电量 ×0.8 分/kWh"与"2 个月最大购电量 ×5 分/kWh"取大；2026 售电办法草案改为 预计年售电量 ×1 分/kWh × 系数 1–10、最低 200 万元，逐日盯市、1/3/1 个工作日补缴恢复。偏差考核全国无统一阈值，1656 号第七十四条给差价/差量结算原则，具体免考区间与考核价看省级细则。
结算与退出：976 号统一 第 5/8/10 个工作日（核对版/正式版/账单），异议 15 个工作日、确认 5 个工作日、下一周期追退补；不得设不平衡资金池；争议可经市场管理委员会、价格/监管调解，再仲裁/诉讼。2026 售电办法草案新增自动减少业务地、自动注销、未履行合同终止与损失承担；保底售电拟从 1.5/2 倍改为按无法履约当月现货实时价格结算。
零售侧风险：2026 年前 7 个月 400+ 家售电公司退出；广东 500 家中 298 家亏损、上半年平均度电收益 0.0039 元/kWh（C 级，媒体/交易中心口径）；固定分时套餐约 11 省退场；低价抢量、阴阳合同、线下返利是高压线。

索引与 HTML：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接（976/1656/1595/2026 三份草案、信用等级、保函公式、偏差与结算时限、观察清单与跨技能边界）；知识中心新增第 42 个模块卡片与 knowledge/html/电力市场风险、信用与结算-2026-11.html 阅读页，首页模块数与总行数同步为 42 / 14,086。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：需求响应、车网互动与灵活性资源知识模块 + HTML 阅读页
items: 新增知识笔记：需求响应、车网互动与灵活性资源-2026-11。定位是资源侧，回答"哪些负荷能调、基线怎么认、响应量怎么算、考核结算怎么扣、V2G 怎么参与市场"；VPP 聚合、控制与商业模式仍归《虚拟电厂专家》，市场规则与分摊归电力交易技能，储能投决与电池退化成本归储能技能，不重复写一套聚合与商业模式。
制度框架：1283 号《电力需求侧管理办法（2023年版）》与 1261 号《电力负荷管理办法（2023年版）》均自 2023-10-01 施行、有效期 5 年；需求响应能力目标为最大负荷的 3%–5%（峰谷差率 >40% 的省份 ≥5%），有序用电方案规模 ≥历史最高负荷 30%、Ⅰ–Ⅵ级每级 5%；明确"先错峰、后避峰、再限电"。

2026 运行图景：夏季全国最大负荷 15.57 亿kW、四创新高，6 个区域电网与 20 个省级电网创新高；31 个省级电网未启动需求响应或有序用电（中电联 2026-11-05，B）；需求侧调节能力 >9,000 万kW、占最大负荷 6.0%+（B）；VPP 2025 年底 470 个项目/1,685 万kW 实测调节能力（A），2026 年行业口径 >530 个/>1,800 万kW（C）。
基线、考核与结算：挂接 DL/T 2162-2020、GB/T 32127、GB/T 37016；给出"5+3"取平均、15 min 采样、25%–200% 修剪、实时前 3 h 修正的基线流程，以及基线操纵的识别与申辩清单；用基线 10 MW、申报 2 MW/2 h 的算例拆解有效响应、补偿与考核，说明基线偏差 0.5 MW 可造成约 3,000 元多付（D）。

省级规则（2026）：广东 233 号替代 356 号，年度峰段交易 0–2,700 元/MWh、最小 0.02 MW、VPP ≥5 MW/≥1 h、系数 1.0/1.4/1.6；江苏快速响应直接控制 15 元/kWh、自主控制 10 元/kWh，首批 27 个直控（6–15，均值 13.17）与 314 个自控（5–10，均值 9.94）；浙江容量 1 元/kW·月 + 电量 2–3 元/kWh；另列广州、海南、福建、河北、安徽、山东、四川、湖南、宁夏、贵州、山西 11 省对照。

车网互动：241 号首批 9 个试点城市 + 30 个项目（部分报道 32 个，已标注差异）；1721 号提出 2030 年千万千瓦级双向灵活性；"十五五"规划提出 2030 年 V2G 聚合可调充电 5,000 万kW（2025 年基础 1,000 万kW）、支撑 1.1 亿辆 EV；"三年倍增"方案提出 2027 年 5,000 个双向设施、2,000 万kWh 反向放电。合成算例：私家车净收益约 2,870 元/年、保本价差 0.381 元/kWh；50 辆公交净 59.75 万元/年（D）。

索引与 HTML：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接（1283/1261/1721/241/三年倍增、基线与响应量口径、省级补偿、V2G 电池与观察清单）；知识中心新增第 41 个模块卡片与 knowledge/html/需求响应、车网互动与灵活性资源-2026-11.html 阅读页，首页模块数与总行数同步为 41 / 12,976。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：量化报价与交易风控知识模块 + HTML 阅读页
items: 新增知识笔记：量化报价与交易风控（工程化）-2026-11。定位是工程层，回答"预测怎么变成报价、报价怎么进系统、结算怎么对上、亏了归因到哪一步、风控限额怎么设"，不重复预测与报价算法本身；算法与模型归《现货报价量化专家》，市场规则与结算公式归电力交易技能，储能投决归储能技能，VPP 聚合控制归 VPP 技能。
2026 规则版本：截至 2026-09-30 至少 11 个省级现货市场正式运行，2026-10-24 南方区域市场转正；2026-10-19 现货新规征求意见稿拟 2027-01-01 施行，反馈截止 2026-11-18；售电公司办法草案拟 2027-01-01，履约保函/保险/保证金最低 200 万元；信用评价 A/B/C/D 按季出结果。
工程闭环：规则参数层→数据契约→概率预测→报价组合→回测门禁→风控限额→结算对账→PnL 归因；每层给出输入输出、失败模式与验收口径；强调"先锁规则版本再做回测"，避免用新规则回测旧策略。
风控与对账：给出 VaR/CVaR、敞口/限额、保函占用、追保与流动性五类限额；对账按"表计—价格—辅助服务—考核—其他"逐项拆差；归因拆为"预测/报价/执行/规则/残差"，并给出 T+1 复盘模板。
合成算例（D 级）：100 MW/400 MWh 储能日净收益约 10.55 万元、年约 3,481 万元、单位约 344.7 元/MWh；10 亿 kWh/年售电公司 base 毛利 0.063 元/kWh、日 17.26 万元，现货 +0.30 元/kWh 时转为 −0.027 元/kWh、10 日亏 74 万元；结算差 −80 万元 与 T+1 归因 −19 万元 均逐项拆解。

索引与 HTML：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接（现货/售电/信用草案、履约保函与 VaR/CVaR 口径、观察清单与跨技能边界）；知识中心新增第 40 个模块卡片与 knowledge/html/量化报价与交易风控-工程化-2026-11.html 阅读页，首页模块数与总行数同步为 40 / 11,940。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：储能技术路线、安全与构网型并网知识模块 + HTML 阅读页
items: 新增知识笔记：储能技术路线安全与构网型并网-2026-11。定位是知识层，回答"选哪条技术路线、安全怎么设防、构网型到底能提供什么、怎么验收和算账"，暂不单独拆技能；项目财务测算归储能投资技能，并网流程与涉网试验归新能源技能，辅助服务结算归电力交易技能，EMS 算法归两份 EMS 底稿。
2026 装机与路线：截至 2026-09，全国新型储能 1.67 亿kW/4.35 亿kWh（+63%），平均时长 2.61 h，1-9 月等效利用 915 h；2027 年目标 1.8 亿kW、带动直接投资约 2,500 亿元；锂离子电池占新型储能装机 96% 以上；2026 年 2–4 h 系统价格常见 0.45–0.60 元/Wh。
技术路线对比：锂电、钠电、全钒液流、压缩空气、飞轮/超级电容、熔盐热储能、重力、氢、抽水蓄能逐条给出时长、效率、循环、寿命、成本、安全与场景；附 100 MW/400 MWh 的 LCOS 粗算：锂电约 0.25–0.32、全钒液流约 0.55–0.65、压缩空气约 0.30–0.38 元/kWh（D 级）。

安全体系：热失控机理与五道防线（电芯→模组→舱→站→应急）；BMS/EMS/PCS/消防联动；全氟己酮、七氟丙烷、细水雾、气溶胶、惰性气体、干粉的适用与局限；标准挂接 GB 44240-2024（2025-08-01 强制实施）、GB/T 51048-2025（2026-04-01）、GB/T 42288-2022、GB/T 46261-2025（2026-09）、GB/T 46957-2025（2026-07-01）、T/CFPA 055-2026。

构网型并网：跟网/构网的电压源与电流源差异、下垂/VSG/VOC/直流侧构网、惯量与 RoCoF 公式、SCR、3 倍/10 s 过流、黑启动与多机振荡；标准挂接 GB/T 47968-2026（2026-11-01，19 项指标、3 倍过流）与 GB/T 47655-2026（2027-02-01，首次国标定义"构网"）；2025 年构网型新增约 7.3 GW/25.2 GWh、渗透率约 12.8%，2026Q1 新增 2.48 GW/6.89 GWh、容量占比约 19.2%（B 级，口径冲突已标注）。
纠错与边界：明确"2026-04-01 全国强制构网""构网渗透率 30% 目标"未检索到国家公开文件，按 C 级/未证实处理；GB 44240-2024 名称是《电能存储系统用锂蓄电池和电池组 安全要求》，不是"安全技术规范"；构网型 PCS 溢价 15%–30%、系统增量 10%–20%（D 级，口径差异大）。

索引与 HTML：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接（1144 号、储能安全与构网标准、容量/时长/构网口径）；知识中心新增第 39 个模块卡片与 knowledge/html/储能技术路线安全与构网型并网-2026-11.html 阅读页，首页模块数与总行数同步为 39 / 10,876。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：省间与跨区交易知识模块 + HTML 阅读页
items: 新增知识笔记：省间与跨区交易-2026-11。定位是知识层，回答"电怎么从送端卖到受端、省间中长期和现货怎么组织、区域市场怎么衔接、输电费和网损怎么算、输电权怎么买"，暂不单独拆技能；省内报价与结算归电力交易专家，外送通道与机制电价归新能源开发专家，跨省套利归储能技能，聚合主体参与归虚拟电厂技能。

市场分层与规模：省间市场、区域市场、省内市场、跨经营区四层不是四套孤立市场。2026 年 1-9 月省间交易 13,037 亿kWh（+9.1%），其中中长期 12,403 亿kWh（95.1%）、现货 578 亿kWh（4.4%）、绿电 575 亿kWh、跨经营区 70 亿kWh；北京 / 广州交易中心分别为 10,897（+11.2%）/ 2,141（−0.6%）亿kWh。跨经营区现货：2025-10-13 两网首次交易（国网组织华东购南网现货，180 万kW / 4,230 万kWh）；2026-07-16 国网今年首次采购南网现货（191 万kW / 2,791 万kWh，均价 351.8 元/MWh）。

2026 年规则变化：1656 号自 2026-03-01 施行并废止 889 号与绿电专章；275 号（2026-04-24 复函、04-28 施行）把省间现货明确为实物交易并要求与省内衔接、严禁行政隐性壁垒；国办发〔2026〕4号给出 2030 年基本建成、2035 年全面建成与"统一报价、联合交易"；915 号建立跨经营区常态化机制；715 号同意南方区域 2026-10-24 转正；734 号自 2026-06-01 在云霄直流试点输电权。

价格与算例（D 级）：2027 年专项工程输电价 0.81–8.36 分/kWh、送出省原则 ≤3 分/kWh。合成算例：受端 0.45 元/kWh 时，青豫送端净价 0.323（溢价 0.073），叠加 50 元/MWh 输电权后降到 0.273；吉泉在 0.45 时仅 0.302，叠加后 0.252，基本无利可图。输电权 100 MW × 300 h × 50 元/MWh 成本 150 万元，盈亏平衡价差 0.05 元/kWh；受端用户 100 GWh、价差 0.07 元/kWh，扣 5% 偏差后年省 650 万元。

索引与 HTML：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接（837/275/915/715/734、专项定价办法与 2027 输电价表）；知识中心新增第 38 个模块卡片与 knowledge/html/省间与跨区交易-2026-11.html 阅读页，首页模块数与总行数同步为 38 / 10,136，04 分类更名为"现货与省间交易"。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：并网运行考核与"两个细则"知识模块
items: 新增知识笔记：并网运行考核与两个细则-2026-11。定位是知识层，回答"两个细则怎么考核、AGC/AVC/一次调频怎么算、哪些能免考、罚多少钱"，暂不单独拆技能；辅助服务市场与结算仍归电力交易专家，并网标准与涉网试验归新能源开发专家，考核扣减归储能投资技能。
文件体系：国家层面为 [2021] 60 号《电力并网运行管理规定》与 61 号《电力辅助服务管理办法》（2021-12-21，管理范围 35 kV 及以上）；区域/省级细则定参数；项目层面靠并网调度协议、涉网试验报告与月度考核结算单。2026-09-30 国家能源局综合司发布《电力并网运行管理规定（征求意见稿）》，拟将"考核"改为"管理"并新增不可抗力、首台（套）豁免，草案不是现行规则。

公式与门槛：AGC 用 K1/K2/K3 合成 Kp（原则 ≤2，分项常见上下限 2/0.1），火电 60 s、水电 20 s，南方按日上网电量 ×（1−合格率）× 0.1%，山东 2026 储能性能基准 K1/K2/K3=1.3/1.7/1.4；AVC 看投运率、调节合格率、无功调用合格率与母线电压合格率，常见 98%/96%/90% 或 99%/99%，安徽按 0.03%/百分点、单项封顶 0.5%；一次调频按 GB/T 40595-2021（死区按电源类型，约 ±0.02~0.067 Hz；调差率 2%~6% 推荐 5%；滞后 ≤1 s）与 GB/T 30370-2013（火电 ±0.033 Hz、调差率 3%~6%、15 s 达 75%）。
罚则与免考：给出 20 项罚则表（触发条件、计量口径、封顶、级别）与六类免考（电网原因、不可抗力、调度指令、计划检修/试验、机组状态、政策试点），并列出七种不予免考情形；免考须在公示期内申请并附证据链，逾期或无证据按自身责任处理。

可证伪的算例（D 级）：合成 300 MW 燃煤机组月上网 15 万 MWh、考核电价 0.40 元/kWh，五项合计考核 2,437.5 MWh、97.50 万元，占月收入 1.63%；其中一次调频、调度纪律、非计划停运三项占 92.3%，AGC 单点只占 0.3%。按南方 0.1%/0.1pp 较严版本，一次调频不封顶为 600 万元，0.5% 封顶把损失压到 30 万元，差 20 倍；合格率需提到 99.9% 才减少 24 万元/月，90%→99% 仍在封顶内、月省为 0。
索引与更新：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接；标注山东 52 号（2026-10-01 施行）、华中 129 号、南方 2024-12-18 修订、华北/华东 2026 草案与山西文号待核实。

entries.label: v1.6 增补：综合能源与零碳园区知识模块
items: 新增知识笔记：综合能源与零碳园区-2026-11。定位是知识层，回答"园区怎么做到零碳、绿电直连能不能算得过账、源网荷储怎么配"，暂不单独拆技能；市场规则、储能测算、碳核算仍分别指向六个技能。
政策与门槛：910 号八项重点任务、1082 号首批 52 个国家级零碳园区、国发〔2026〕22号"十五五"100 个左右零碳园区与 500 个左右零碳工厂；650/688 号自用 ≥60%、≥30%（2030 年前 35%）、上网 ≤20%；1192 号按容（需）量缴输配电费，下网电量不再缴系统备用费与输配环节电量电费；280 号源网荷储三个层级；1044 号绿证全覆盖。
价格机制读法：广东 1848 号公式中，730 小时是折算小时数，平均负荷率是省级公布参数（吉林明确每年 11 月底公布），接入公共电网容量是项目唯一可控变量；储能、负荷管理与错峰生产都能降容量、降输配电费。
可证伪的算例：合成园区原全口径 0.6756 元/kWh，直连后 0.6130 元/kWh，年省 1,876.92 万元；临界 LCOE 约 0.267 元/kWh，高于此值直连不如直接买电；弃电率从 28% 降到 10%，年省扩大到 3,524.92 万元；接入容量从 63 MVA 降到 50 MVA，相对原模式年省 3,028.20 万元（相对直连基准的增量为 1,151.28 万元）。
索引与纠错：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接；注明首批是 52 个而非 56 个、绿电直连 100 个/3410 万 kW 与 99 个/3405 万 kW 的时点差异、35% 门槛的两种原文表述。

entries.label: v1.6：新增新能源项目开发与并网专家
items: 新增第六份技能：新能源项目开发与并网专家（中英文）。覆盖集中式风电、集中式光伏、海上风电与分布式光伏的八个开发阶段，回答"项目能不能开发、能不能并网、能不能过投决"；市场规则与结算仍归电力交易专家，电价预测与报价归现货报价量化专家，配储经济性归储能投资与运营专家。

附零依赖参考实现：skills/renewable-project-development/tools/（resource/lcoe/mechanism/finance/selftest，仅标准库）。python tools/selftest.py 断言正文算例：P90 2,153.93 h、风电容量系数 27.40%、Weibull 筛查 27.92%、光伏比发电量 1,407.12 kWh/kWp；LCOE 252.80/283.94/446.43 元/MWh；机制电价结算 6,774.48 万元；NPV 596.3 万元、IRR 8.18%、回收期 9.55 年、DSCR 1.76；组合压力 NPV −9,404.85 万元、IRR 5.28%。
可证伪的结论：LCOE 不是投标底线——算例 A 税前 LCOE 252.80 元/MWh，但 8% 门槛下税后保本机制价为 294.85 元/MWh，高约 42 元/MWh；机制电价从 0.30 降到 0.244 元/kWh，项目从"刚过 8%"变为 NPV −5,893.1 万元、IRR 6.15%；资源、造价、捕获价同时不利时 IRR 降至 5.28%。
维护件与索引：新增 新能源项目开发与并网-2026-11；双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 挂接；版本号统一升至 v1.6，校验脚本增加第六对技能与新能源数字中英校验，CI 增加新能源工具自测。

entries.label: v1.5 增补：中国电价知识模块
items: 新增四篇电价知识笔记：电价史、制度谱系、现行政策与查证、国际比较方法与模板。定位是知识层：讲清"电价怎么走到今天、由哪几段构成、现在按哪些文件执行、跨国怎么比"，不重复技能正文里的市场规则与报价方法。
电价史分五阶段：1949-1985 统一目录价与集资办电、1985-2002 经营期电价与农网改造、2002-2015 标杆电价/煤电联动/可再生能源标杆/居民阶梯、2015-2021 输配电价与现货试点/1439 号文、2021-2026 容量电价与 136/411/1656/114 号文。每阶段写清谁定价、按什么形式定价、成本怎么疏导、留下什么问题。
制度谱系按三环节拆价：上网电价、输配电价（准许收入 = 准许成本 + 合理收益 + 税金）、销售电价；给出容量/辅助服务/环保电价、线损、系统运行费、政府性基金、两部制与 105% 需量规则，并附合成账单算例（200 MWh、0.858 元/kWh）与十种口径、九个常见错误。
现行政策按文号查：14 份现行文件总表（742/1583/500/1093/1439/809/1047/1217/1501/136/411/1656/114/国办发 4 号），2026 年四条主线（分时重构、容量电价扩围、新能源机制电价、系统成本），用户侧四步查证法与省别样本表。
国际比较只给方法与模板：五步口径统一、六行科目拆解（电能量/输电/配电/系统服务/税费附加/增值税）、国别卡片 YAML 模板；用合成 A/B 两国示例说明名义价格排名在购买力平价下会翻转。国家数据留待后续版本逐国填入，不先给未经核实的排名。
索引与分工：双语 README、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 与 knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 各补入口；电价制度与历史归本模块，市场规则与结算仍归电力交易专家，项目测算归储能投资技能。

entries.label: v1.5
items: 新增第五份技能：储能投资与运营专家（中英文）。覆盖独立/共享储能、新能源配储、工商业用户侧、火储联合、微网与 VPP 聚合六种形态；回答"值不值得投、收益怎么堆、考核怎么扣"。市场规则与结算仍归电力交易专家，调度算法指向 knowledge/ 下的两份 EMS 底稿。

附零依赖参考实现：skills/storage-investment-operations/tools/（stacking/finance/degradation/selftest，仅标准库）。python tools/selftest.py 断言正文算例：独立储能年净套利 3,106.9 万元、容量电费 550 万元、NPV 3,119.4 万元、IRR 10.47%、LCOS 742.24/458.15 元/MWh、DSCR 1.53；用户侧 IRR 12.59%、回收期 5.52 年；配储 IRR 4.98%/0.26%。

2026-11 政策与成本事实：114 号文容量电价公式与安徽 165 元/kW·年、6 h 分母（2/4/6 h 折 1/3、2/3、1）；1656 号文取消政府定分时，浙江价差 0.83→0.50 元/kWh（−28.5%）、江苏 0.85→0.65（−25%，C 级）；411 号文辅助服务品种；136 号文配储不享容量电价；1583/500 号文合同最大需量 105% 加倍；2026-09/10 招中标区间与 GB/T 36549-2018 指标口径。
可证伪的结论：独立储能基准"能过但不高"，容量电价归零即 NPV −411 万元；用户侧需量节省占收入 51%，需量收益归零则回收期拉到约 8.8 年；配储对弃电是否免费极度敏感。敏感性显示价差与循环次数最敏感，CAPEX 与容量电价决定过不过线。
维护件与索引：新增 储能投资与运营-2026-11；README、双语索引与口径手册挂接；版本号统一升至 v1.5，校验脚本增加第五对技能与储能数字中英校验，CI 增加储能工具自测。

entries.label: v1.4
items: 新增第四份技能：碳资产管理专家（中英文）。覆盖履约日历、配额盈缺、CEA/CCER 采购、CCER 开发测算、碳金融工具、碳价情景、电碳核算与 CBAM；定位是"怎么履约、怎么测算、怎么融资"，电力市场规则仍归电力交易专家。

附零依赖参考实现：skills/carbon-asset-expert/tools/（compliance/ccer/finance/calendar_tool/selftest，仅标准库）。python tools/selftest.py 断言正文算例：配额 800 万吨、缺口 60 万吨、采购成本 5,445.3 万元、5 倍罚款 1.35 亿元；CCER 项目 NPV −309.5 万元、IRR 6.25%、盈亏平衡价 89.61 元/吨；质押追保价 71.25 元/吨；七个履约节点可导出 ICS。
2026-11 事实与纠错：覆盖 3,680 家/约 83 亿吨；CCER 抵销上限 5%、2026-10 中 44 个项目、均价 86.51 元/吨；CBAM 2026-01-01 实施但证书 2027-02 起购买、首次清缴 2027-09-30；碳期货截至 2026-11 未上市；绿证按年份 0.56/1.60/6.16 元/张。
碳技能扩展（产品与贸易侧）：第 11 章改为"产品碳足迹、CBAM 与绿色贸易"，新增 PCF 边界/分配/因子（算例 12.4 kg/kg、抵消 892.8 元）、ISO 14068:2026 碳中和声明、供应链碳数据、DPP/电池护照（2027-02-18）、碳数据跨境；新增 §9.6 碳数据增信与 §12.6 碳数据治理；CCER 上限口径统一为"5% × 核查排放/应清缴义务"。
参考实现同步：新增 pcf.py（生命周期汇总、强度、阶段占比、共产品分配、减排后残余、抵消成本）与 allocation_with_certification_bonus、carbon_linked_loan_savings，selftest.py 断言正文全部新算例。
维护件与分工：新增 碳资产实务-2026-11 与 碳管理与碳足迹厂商调研；电力交易专家第 10 章保留市场规则与碳价概览并加指针；版本号统一升至 v1.4，校验脚本增加第四对技能与碳数字中英校验，CI 增加碳工具自测。

entries.label: v1.3 增补：电力系统通识
items: 新增知识库四篇：格局与主体、发输配变用、改革史、新角色与现货市场。定位是通识层：给没有电力背景的读者补齐机构、术语与历史，不承载省别规则参数与报价方法。
三处口径提醒写进正文：五大集团装机占比不给当期值（注明查中电联）；"四小"为历史称谓且国华已并入国家能源集团；系统运行费涨幅必须注明省份与月份。
索引挂接：双语 README 的技能区入口与结构树、knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md 文件地图、knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md 的跨技能归属边界各补一条，明确通识内容不在技能正文里重复。

entries.label: v1.3
items: 新增第三份技能：现货报价量化专家（中英文）。覆盖数据层与防泄露、负荷/电价/出力预测、残差校正、量价曲线与申报量决策、售电购电组合、竞价仿真、滚动回测与 T+1 四项归因。定位是"怎么算、怎么报、怎么验证"，市场规则与结算仍归电力交易专家，资源聚合与运营归虚拟电厂专家。
附零依赖参考实现与合成数据：skills/spot-bidding-quant/tools/（forecast/bid/simulate/backtest/selftest，仅标准库）+ data/sample/synthetic_spot_60d.csv（60 天 × 96 点，固定种子生成，非实盘）。python tools/selftest.py 断言正文指标，正文与代码不一致会直接失败。
可证伪的结论：价格接受者的最优报价等于边际成本（不给价格接受者算加价）；枢机机组按剩余需求定价；储能套利门槛=循环成本/效率（样例 68.2 元/MWh）；合成样例上负荷修正后 MAE 较季节朴素改善 10.8%，电价方向正确率 61.4%。
厂商信息按两侧整理并分级：参与侧（上海路明星光，效果数字一律 C 级、不作基准）与运营/规则侧（北京清能互联，2026-05 中标南方区域现货技术支持系统"出清算法相关功能加装改造"标包 462 万元，B 级招标公告）。据此新增第 10.4 节"生产级出清引擎 vs 教学仿真"，讲清 SCUC/SCED/RUC/联合出清/跨经营区/容量六个环节缺一环会怎样影响结论。
合规边界：不提供规避监管的报价手法、经济/容量持留方案与合谋策略；市场力内容只作识别与合规自查；仿真结论必须标注"机制演示，非收益预测"。

entries.label: v2.5 release: asset trading custody and agency, 130 modules
items: Scope and status: adds one knowledge module, modules 129 → 130; Q&A stays at 86 and open items at 55. Published as v2.5; the site version moves v2.4 → v2.5 (18 SKILLs, bilingual READMEs/CHANGELOGs, consistency assertion, version badge and changelog dialog), and the data cutoff moves to 2026-11-27. Build, --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and nine Python self-tests pass; every example is synthetic grade D.

Asset trading custody and agency (spot #16): adds *Asset Trading Custody and Agency: Authorization Boundaries, Benchmark Design and Performance Attribution* — buy-side versus sell-side agency; three custody levels (report-only, delegated operation, full custody); a six-dimension authorization matrix (market, product, time, volume, price, decision rights) with veto rules; four benchmark families (market average, peer capture price, theoretical available generation, forecast-adjusted) and eight calibre fields; five sharing structures (fixed fee, floor plus share, benchmark plus share, benchmark plus two-way share, progressive tiers); the one-sided call option in “share the upside, no downside” (the agent's payout is s × max(0, R_actual − R_benchmark) + F, so a 30% share with floor 100 turns a −585m downside into a 100m cap and leaves the asset owner about −545m); six attribution buckets (price, volume split into availability/curtailment/settlement, forecast deviation, execution slippage, scope, service fee); six conflicts of interest (multi-client allocation, proprietary trading, related-party transactions, benchmark manipulation, customer conflict, data conflict); twelve clause families; and a 10-question due-diligence list.

Grade-D synthetic case: a 100 MW wind farm with benchmark available generation 300 GWh at a benchmark price of 380 CNY/MWh, benchmark revenue CNY 114m; actual settled volume 285 GWh (10 GWh curtailed, 5 GWh availability/resource loss) at a capture price of 400 CNY/MWh, actual revenue CNY 114m. Price effect +585m, curtailment −390m, availability −195m, net difference 0. Sharing on the price effect × 30% pays 175.5m plus a 60m service fee and leaves the asset 235.5m below benchmark; sharing on the net difference × 30% pays 0 plus 60m and leaves it 60m below; a two-way 30% with a 100m floor pays 0 plus 60m in the base case and caps the agent at 100m in the −585m downside, leaving the asset −545m. In a good year (295 GWh, 410 CNY/MWh) the net difference is +695m, the agent receives 268.5m and the asset nets 11,826.5m. With symmetric ±20 CNY/MWh outcomes and no skill, the “upside-only” structure gives the agent an expected 90m while the asset owner's expected net is −150m including the fee.

Counts and generated artifacts: modules/reading pages/Chinese Markdown become 130 and 129+1; body 57,741 → 58,448 lines (+707); search-index 4,527,472 → 4,573,684 bytes and changelog records 102 → 103; config, indexes, English index, badge and bilingual READMEs are synchronised, with an asset-custody route added under “Find an entry point by question”; the hub, search index, credibility, English digest and changelog data are rebuilt, followed by build --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and nine Python self-tests.

Review and copyright: original rewrite that cites a public interview (grade C), a listed-company investor-relations record (grade B) and policy document numbers (grade A) without copying source text; the module distinguishes generator-side agency from the user-side agency already covered in the retail-procurement note and links to it instead of repeating it; all examples are synthetic grade D and contain no real contract prices, settled volumes, plant output, coal prices, channel contracts or commercial-project provenance.

entries.label: v2.4 release: three electricity-trading modules — contract structure, monthly review and retail procurement
items: Scope and release: adds three knowledge modules, modules 126 → 129; Q&A stays at 86 and open items at 55. Published as v2.4; the site version moves v2.3 → v2.4 (18 SKILLs, bilingual READMEs/CHANGELOGs, consistency assertion, version badge and changelog dialog); build, --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and nine Python self-tests pass; the data cutoff remains 2026-11-19 and all examples are synthetic grade D.

Medium/long-term contract structure and signing assessment (spot #13): adds *Medium/Long-Term Contract Structure and Signing Assessment: From Annual to Intra-Month* — annual, monthly, intra-month and multi-day windows; sequencing of green power, bilateral, centralised auction and agency listing; signing ratios of 70% for coal (relaxable to 60%), 45–80% for users and 80% for monthly-and-longer contracts, together with their denominators; bilateral limits on counterparties, volume, minimum centralised-trading share and method; four assessment families (fixed fee, spread clawback, notification/guarantee, no annual assessment); coverage, effective coverage, value-weighted coverage and basis risk; 2027 rule changes in Jiangxi, Shaanxi and Beijing. Grade-D 1,000 GWh case: 70/20/10 vs. 60/30/10 cost CNY 392/400/408m vs. 390/402/414m at monthly prices of 360/400/440 CNY/MWh; break-even 380 CNY/MWh; under a 1.5x spread clawback, signing 100 GWh less loses CNY 2m.

Monthly market monitoring and review (spot #14): adds *Monthly Market Monitoring and Review: From Fuel and Inflows to Capture Rates* — four layers of questions, 12 indicators, a calibre card and data tiers; fuel/marginal cost, supply/demand/inflows/wind-solar/maintenance, spot averages/percentiles/anomaly days, contracts versus spot, settlement by source, capture price/rate/mechanism price, storage arbitrage/frequency/capacity/delivery, interprovincial/green certificates/agency procurement and a policy list. Grade-D 30-day case: normal-day simple average 304.2, month average with three anomaly days 309.2, load-weighted 340.9 CNY/MWh; four PV capture rates 49.3%/48.5%/44.9%/44.0%; storage net spread 325.3 CNY/MWh, arbitrage CNY 14.248m/yr at 60% delivery, CNY 24.248m/yr including capacity.

Retail and wholesale-user procurement portfolios (spot #15): adds *Retail and Wholesale-User Procurement Portfolios: Linked Retail, Switching to Wholesale and Agency Trading* — three identities and cost decomposition; the 2027 Sichuan draft's linked price plus floating price and 1.6/0.4 time-of-use guidance; wholesale annual 60%, monthly 80–120% and 20% spot-exposure constraints; the six-term switching formula and threshold; agency benchmarking, sharing, cost-sharing, caps and conflicts of interest. Grade-D 100 GWh case: at floating prices of 2/5/10 CNY/MWh, switching saves −5/−2/+3 CNY/MWh, with a threshold of 7 CNY/MWh; with a 5 CNY/MWh bias and no trading capability the net saving is −3 CNY/MWh; 1.6 GWh of over-contract is recovered at 50 CNY/MWh × 1.1 = CNY 88,000.

Counts and generated artifacts: modules/reading pages/Chinese Markdown become 129 and 128+1; body 55,950 → 57,741 lines (+1,791); search-index 4,426,880 → 4,527,472 bytes and changelog records 101 → 102; config, indexes, English index, badge and bilingual READMEs are synchronised, with a three-module route added under “Find an entry point by question”; the hub, search index, credibility, English digest and changelog data are rebuilt, followed by build --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and nine Python self-tests.

All three notes are original rewrites that cite public policy numbers and mechanisms without copying source articles; all examples are synthetic grade D and contain no real contract prices, settled volumes, plant output, channel contracts or commercial-project provenance.

entries.label: v2.3 release: protection/BMS/siting and foundations F/G, five tools and Q&A at 86 questions
items: Scope and release: adds five knowledge modules, five deterministic tools and a P-group Q&A set; knowledge modules 121 → 126, Q&A 81 → 86, open items 50 → 55. Published as v2.3; the site version moves v2.2 → v2.3 (18 SKILLs, bilingual READMEs/CHANGELOGs, consistency assertion, version badge and changelog dialog); build, --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and both Python self-tests pass; the data cutoff remains 2026-11-19 and all examples are synthetic grade D.

Microgrid and storage-station protection (storage #12): adds *Microgrid and Storage-Station Protection Setting: From IBR Fault Current to Grid/Islanded Setting Groups* — converter current limiting, bidirectional flow and two physical regimes; per-unit and sequence networks; overcurrent, zero-sequence, differential and anti-islanding configuration; setting, sensitivity and CTI coordination; setting-group switching and blocking; commissioning and acceptance; ten common errors. Grade-D 10 kV case: grid 10.974/9.083 kA, islanded 0.729/0.656 kA, R1 0.73/0.30 kA, sensitivity 12.44/2.19, CTI 0.319/0.350 s, zero-sequence 400/40 A with sensitivity 10.

BMS and storage EMS state boundary (storage #13): adds *BMS and Storage EMS State Boundaries: SOC/SOH/SOP, Balancing and Safety Interlocks* — BMS/EMS time scales and interface contracts; coulomb-counting, OCV and model-based SOC; SOH capacity, resistance and life calibres; SOP temperature/SOC derating; passive and active balancing; layered interlocks, state machine and fault levels; data and communications; ten common errors. Grade-D 100 MW/200 MWh case: SOC 14.286% vs. OCV 15.0% (+0.714 pp), SOH 95.1%/266.28 Ah, SOP 100/70/20 MW, balancing 89.6 Wh at 0.32 W for 280 h.

Grid-side storage siting and sizing (storage #14): adds *Grid-Side Storage Siting and Sizing with Reliability/Resilience Value* — value stack and double-counting traps; EENS/LOLE/VoLL and capacity credit; screen-then-optimise siting; power/energy/duration sizing; CRF/NPV/BCR; the reliability-resilience boundary; ten common errors. Grade-D three-bus case: EENS 160 → 80 → 0 MWh/yr, NPV CNY 1.645m/3.290m/−52.775m, BCR 1.034/1.034/0.450, showing that a wrong location cannot be rescued by more capacity.

Foundations F/G (foundation #7/#8): adds *Power-System Foundations F · Operations and Dispatch: From Day-Ahead Plan to Real-Time Balance* and *Power-System Foundations G · Planning and Resource Adequacy: From Load Forecast to Generation-Grid Portfolio* — the former covers the operations timeline, SCUC/SCED, security checking, real-time re-dispatch, AGC, post-contingency reserve and institutions; the latter covers load forecasting, LOLE/EENS, capacity credit, portfolio diversity, grid planning and uncertainty methods. Grade-D cases: three-unit day-ahead/real-time/AGC/contingency (250/50 MW at CNY 97,500; 300/60 MW at CNY 117,000; AGC 20 MW shifts to gas; 40 MW reserve against 80 MW after the outage) and two portfolios (A: LOLE 203.344 h/yr, EENS 53,892 MWh/yr; B: 1.560 h/yr, 332.29 MWh/yr).

Runnable tools and self-tests: adds skills/ems-dispatch/tools/protection.py, bms.py, siting.py, operations.py and planning.py, standard-library only, deterministic and --json; selftest.py adds groups O–S covering fault current, settings/CTI, SOC/SOH/SOP/balancing, EENS/NPV/BCR, day-ahead/real-time/AGC/reserve and LOLE/EENS.

Q&A, indexes and skills: Q&A adds group P (Q82–Q86: protection setting, BMS boundaries, storage siting, operations, resource adequacy); monthly sampling 16 → 17 and quarterly full test 86. The Chinese index adds a section-8 routing table and P-group regression entry; the English index adds five file-map rows, Q&A 86 and open items #51–#55; knowledge.config.mjs links the five modules into the storage, EMS, trading and renewable skills.

Counts and generated artifacts: modules/reading pages/Chinese Markdown become 126 and 125+1; body 52,584 → 55,950 lines (+3,366); the maintenance ledger adds three P2 and two P3 rows (P2 42→45, P3 9→11); badges and README counts are synchronised; search-index 4,267,468 → 4,426,880 bytes and changelog records 100 → 101; the hub, search index, credibility and English digest are rebuilt, followed by build --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance and both Python self-tests.

Review fixes: the five modules were re-checked against current standards and tool output. GB/T 34120-2023 is titled “technical requirements”, GB 44240-2024 is titled “safety requirements”, and GB 51048 is updated to GB/T 51048-2025 *Standard for Design of Electrochemical Energy Storage Station* (effective 2026-04-01, replacing the 2014 edition). The protection module now states the 4 MW/0.95 pf islanded-load assumption and protection.py computes it. BMS now uniformly uses 3% derating per °C above 35 °C, a 16-cell teaching simplification, and separate capacity-corrected, full-window and current-SOC energy figures, with bms.py exposing an energy block. F uses MW per dispatch interval, restricts normal reserve to thermal spinning reserve, reports the post-contingency 40 MW on a power basis with a 40 MWh / 1 h duration limit, and operations.py now outputs remaining energy and duration. G consistently labels the 2.4 h/yr target as an example. Siting discloses that EENS uses full nameplate energy with no SOC window, RTE or O&M, and that doubling capex roughly halves the BCR. The storage-investment, electricity-trading, EMS and renewable skill summaries are synchronised with the new modules. Self-tests add islanded-load, near-end sensitivity, BMS energy and reserve-duration assertions.

entries.label: v2.2 release: dynamic security and wideband oscillation pair, dynamics/impedance tools and Q&A at 81 questions
items: Release scope and version: publishes this maintenance batch as v2.2; site version v2.1 → v2.2 (18 SKILLs, bilingual READMEs/CHANGELOGs, consistency assertion, version badge and changelog dialog); build, --check, province matrix, consistency, maintenance, git diff --check and both Python selftests pass.

Dynamic-security module (1): adds *Dynamic Security Assessment and Emergency Control: From Static N-1 to Transient Stability* (storage #11, sections 0–13 plus quick reference) — the boundary between static N-1 and dynamic security, rotor-angle/voltage/frequency stability, equal-area criterion and CCT, RK4 time-domain simulation and online DSA, preventive/emergency/third defence lines, generation rejection, fast valving, braking resistor, HVDC modulation and islanding, UFLS/UVLS, IBR fault-current limits and grid-forming, model validation and stability margin, and ten common errors. Synthetic SMIB case: delta0 11.537°, deltac 84.550°, deltamax 156.422°, equal-area and simulated CCT both 0.3677 s; stable at 0.30 s (maximum angle 94.77°), unstable at 0.45 s after about 0.529 s; idealised generation rejection extends CCT to 0.5084 s with a 111.66° maximum angle at 0.45 s; RoCoF for 1000 MW loss / 100 GW / H=4 s is -0.0625 Hz/s.

Wideband-oscillation module (1): adds *Wideband Oscillation and Plant Impedance Analysis: From Impedance Scanning to Parameter Tuning* (renewable #6, sections 0–13 plus quick reference) — sub/super-synchronous versus 5–3000 Hz wideband calibres, SSR/SSTI/SSCI, positive-sequence impedance and Nyquist/negative-resistance criteria, plant impedance modelling and scanning, PLL/current-loop/virtual-impedance/GFM tuning, field diagnosis and grid-connection acceptance, and ten common errors. Synthetic 35 kV / 100 MVA case: grid series resonance 180.0 Hz, total resonance 160.997 Hz, R -0.02998 pu, zeta -0.00931, negative-damping band 98.8–221.2 Hz; required virtual resistance 0.05998 pu; the example tunes to 30 Hz + 0.04 pu, giving R +0.03003 pu, zeta +0.00933 and no negative band.

Runnable tools: adds skills/ems-dispatch/tools/dynamics.py (equal-area CCT, RK4 time domain, rejection CCT, RoCoF, inertia sweep) and oscillation.py (positive-sequence impedance scan, resonances, negative-damping bands, damping ratio, virtual-resistance tuning, PLL-bandwidth sweep), standard library only, deterministic, --json; selftest.py adds section M (transient stability/inertia) and N (impedance scan/tuning) locking every figure above.

Q&A 79 → 81: adds group O (Q80–Q81, transient stability and wideband oscillation) — why dynamic security is needed beyond N-1 and how CCT/rejection/RoCoF support emergency control; why a plant oscillates, how an impedance scan allocates responsibility, and how to tune virtual resistance and PLL bandwidth. Monthly spot check 15 → 16; quarterly full run 81.

entries.label: v2.0 maintenance: AGC/AVC and state-estimation pair, control/security tools and Q&A at 79 questions
items: Control-layer module (1): adds *AGC/AVC and the Frequency-Voltage Loop: From ACE to Plant Assessment* (storage #9, 0–12 plus quick reference) — primary/secondary/tertiary frequency-control boundaries, ACE sign convention and CPS, AGC allocation under regulation range / participation factor / ramp, three-level AVC and plant reactive allocation, response/ramp/accuracy/stability/availability assessment, latency and safety interlocks, and ten common misreadings. Synthetic grade-D case: ACE = 40 MW (20 tie-line + 20 frequency); 40 MW split into 30 MW coal and 10 MW storage (weights 24:8); AVC needs 60 Mvar (PV 30 / SVG 30 / storage 0 at 0.99→1.02 pu, 0.0005 pu/Mvar); primary frequency 20 MW, 2% droop, ±0.03 Hz deadband, 0.10 Hz deviation → 1.4 MW; coal accuracy 95.0%, ramp ratio 0.95, response 12 s; storage 98.0%, 1.00, 3 s.

Network-analysis module (1): adds *State Estimation and Security Analysis: From SCADA Measurements to a Trusted Operating State* (storage #10, 0–12 plus quick reference) — topology processing and network model, observability and pseudo-measurements, DC WLS and normalized residuals, bad-data/topology/parameter errors, N-1 scanning and ATC, security-constrained dispatch, the SE→AGC/AVC/ED interface and ten common errors. Synthetic 3-bus case: 7 measurements / 2 states; bad P13 0.180 vs true 0.150 pu; WLS θ2=−0.020539, θ3=−0.031470 rad, J=27.18, normalized residual 5.21; after removal θ2=−0.020000, θ3=−0.030000; N-1 outage of 1-2 leaves 1-3 at 0.350 pu against a 0.300 limit, 0.050 pu = 5 MW; a 0.05 pu local injection at bus3 restores 0.300 pu.

Runnable tools: adds skills/ems-dispatch/tools/control.py (ACE, AGC allocation, performance components, AVC allocation, droop response; standard library only, deterministic, --json) and state.py (3-bus DC flow, WLS, residual covariance and normalized residuals, N-1 scan; standard library only, deterministic, --json); selftest.py adds sections K (AGC/AVC closed loop) and L (state estimation and N-1) locking every figure above.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: six provincial rulepacks and pre-bid checks
items: Rulepacks: adds six schema-v1 files under skills/electricity-trading-expert/rules/ for Shandong, Gansu, Mengxi, Shanxi, Guangdong and Jiangsu, consolidating spot price limits, points/MTU, capacity compensation, ancillary services, retail, direct-connection and interprovincial rules that were scattered across instance configs, knowledge pages and announcements. Each block carries status, effective_from/effective_to, grade and source; drafts and historical calibers are kept separate, and unresolved items live in open_items.

Checker: adds the zero-dependency, read-only tools/rulecheck.py. It reads an instance's instance.json, the latest out/**/summary.json and an optional bid CSV, checking rule validity, points/MTU, hard and soft price limits, thermal minimum output, storage power and approximate SOC, PV-plus-storage net export, capacity eligibility aliases, ancillary overlap, and retail/direct/interprovincial clauses. It writes out/rulecheck/rulecheck.md and rulecheck.json, uses pass/warn/block/skip, and treats warnings as failure under --strict. It never connects to a trading system or submits quotes. Price columns are detected from the header; partially blank dates or prices, a missing RTE and a malformed summary degrade to warnings, and a block is never overwritten by a later warning in the same check.

Demo and tests: the 12-pack demo covers six provincial markets and currently reports BLOCK 0 / WARN 11 / PASS 1; every warning is an unverified deadline, partial price limit, soft asset band, grade-D parameter or open item, never a silent pass. selftest.py gains section M and grows to 456 assertions covering effective/expired periods, hard/partial/model levels, price bands, coverage/duplicates/dates, partial blank dates or prices, block-versus-warning precedence, capacity aliases, missing-RTE warnings and report generation.

It reads only each pack's out/**/summary.json and adjacent bridge.json, and writes portfolio_summary.json, brief.md and portfolio.csv. Records are grouped by horizon × value_kind × trading_day; daily net margin, revenue, annual profit and saving-versus-benchmark stay separate, and different trading days are never added together. Group-level actual-minus-reference uses only subjects with both values and reports a separate "comparable reference". The CVaR figure is a simple sum of standalone 10% quantiles across the group (including subjects without actuals) and is labelled as not a joint CVaR; missing actuals remain N/A.

Monthly scorecard: adds tools/review.py, which recursively reads <archive>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<instance>/summary.json (with optional bridge.json) and writes scorecard.md, kpis.csv, runs.csv and review_summary.json. Nine KPIs each carry a sample count: actual coverage, plan/energy MAPE, CVaR hits, capture ratio, assessment share, bridge residual, warning density and hedge-ratio deviation. Thresholds can be overridden with --thresholds; duplicate runs keep the newest file and are reported separately; annual/monthly packs never enter the daily statistics.

Demo and calibers: on the 12-pack demo's focus day, 2026-11-18, five packs are on the net-margin caliber and one on revenue. Net margin has a full-universe expectation of 1.144 million CNY and reference of 1.199 million; three subjects have actuals and all three are comparable, with actual 731,000, comparable reference 778,000, and actual-minus-reference −46,800 (−6.0%), plus a simple CVaR sum of 459,000. The scorecard demo has nine daily runs (seven with actuals) and skips three annual/monthly packs: actual coverage 77.8%, plan MAPE 10.5%, energy MAPE 1.5%, CVaR hits 7/7, bridge residual 2.33e-10. All figures are grade-D synthetic data and not trading advice.

The link also carries hreflang, lang, aria-label and title, with screen-reader text "Switch to Chinese" on English pages.
No duplicate entry: the language item is removed from the "More" menu, which now keeps only the source file and method links. Topbar order is language → theme → more (contents joins below 900px).

Styling and responsive checks: the button matches the theme control at 32px on desktop and 44px touch height below 900px, reusing --control-line / --accent for border and hover. No horizontal overflow at 1440, 390 or 320px; dark mode at 390px also stays clean, and every topbar control remains inside the viewport on both the Chinese and English pages.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: nine instance packs, instance layer grows to 23 packs / 11 provinces / 9 skills
items: Scope and structure: nine one-province-one-entity instance packs are added in one round, growing the instance layer from 14 packs / 8 provinces / 6 skills with instances to 23 packs / 11 provincial markets / 9 skills. Two schemas now sit side by side: solicitation/fast-response (96-point event chain, resources/portfolio) and resource-allocation/monthly (12 monthly CSV rows, asset/facility/assets/project/holdings plus policy.strategies/modes). All nine are JSON and CSV edits only; every demo is grade-D synthetic data and corresponds to no real entity; no new knowledge modules, skills or sections (still 101 / 13 / 9).

Carbon compliance (Shandong cement): skills/carbon-asset-expert/instances/shandong-cement-carbon-2025/, compliance year 2025. Benchmark 0.86 tCO2/t clinker, 1.55 Mt clinker, 1.43 Mt verified emissions and a 97 kt gap; the 5% CCER cap is 71.5 kt, all 40 kt available is used, and 20 kt held plus 37 kt purchased CEA cost 6.8961 million CNY; buying CEA only costs 288,000 more, and a 10× non-surrender penalty reaches 34.151 million; the CCER break-even price is 91.30 CNY/t (CEA 92.30 plus transaction-cost difference); the cheapest month is an ex-post figure, not a procurement recommendation; fingerprint 26f9f050aba2.

Zero-carbon park microgrid EMS (Jiangsu): skills/ems-dispatch/instances/jiangsu-zero-carbon-park-ems-2026-11/, 6 MWp PV plus 2 MW/4 MWh storage, grid-connected without export, 96-point representative day. The baseline monthly cost is 254,100 CNY; energy arbitrage alone costs 273,670 (peak 5,400→5,990 kW, demand charge 23,600 higher); a 4,500 kW demand cap cuts it to 214,235 (39,866 saved). Energy-intensity carbon falls 2.885→2.813 tCO2/tce, and the reduction comes from absorbing 2.20 MWh of otherwise-curtailed PV. The night island window needs 4.49 MWh but only 3.00 MWh is usable, so it cannot last four hours; fingerprint 696a22fd40dd.

Renewable development decision (Yunnan wind): skills/renewable-project-development/instances/yunnan-wind-development-2027/, 100 MW, P50 2,850 h, 2027 mechanism price 0.3351 CNY/kWh (public-notice grade C). First-year net output 270,750 MWh, mechanism volume 65% = 175,987.5 MWh, total revenue 79.2221 million CNY, all-in 0.2926 CNY/kWh and pre-tax LCOE 258.87 CNY/MWh; NPV +3.8458 million, IRR 8.11%, payback 9.51 years. Any single adverse move in capex, output, opex, curtailment, capture rate, coverage or P90 resource pushes IRR below 8%; the combined stress gives IRR 3.06%, NPV −172.3189 million and minimum DSCR 1.01; fingerprint 886b410b3fdc.

Interprovincial spot and cross-region green power (Gansu wind to Shandong): skills/electricity-trading-expert/instances/gansu-wind-to-shandong-2026-11/, 200 MW, 70% contracted, transmission price 0.0821 CNY/kWh and 5% line loss. Contract net price (including green premium) 0.2412, spot residual 0.1671 and local 0.2200 CNY/kWh; all-local revenue is 105.60 million CNY, contract plus local residual reaches 112.7132 million (+7.1132), while contract plus interprovincial spot residual falls to 105.0548 million (−0.5452). Export volume is not "the more the better"; marginal volume follows net price.

Multi-user green direct connection (Guangdong): skills/retail-electricity-risk/instances/guangdong-multi-user-direct-2026-11/, 100 MW wind plus 100 MW PV and three corporate users. Self-use/available generation is 73.75%, self-use/total consumption 98.33% and the 57,800 MWh export stays within 20%; direct-connection cost is 486.77 versus 675.60 CNY/MWh under the original mode, saving 56.648 million CNY a year, with a break-even LCOE of 361.62 CNY/MWh; four allocation bases are compared side by side and all four eligibility tests pass.

Coal capacity price plus ancillary services (Gansu): skills/electricity-trading-expert/instances/gansu-coal-capacity-ancillary-2026-11/, 2×660 MW public coal, reliable-capacity payment 330 CNY/kW-yr. Annual output 7,310,160 MWh, capacity payment 370.26 million CNY, ancillary 88.1892 million, annual profit 436.4295 million, 59.70 CNY/MWh; break-even coal price 892 CNY/t (base 700) and spot-price multiple 0.45. The capacity payment is only 13.76% of revenue but equals 84.8% of profit; after three assessments zero it, profit falls to 66.1695 million, and the combined stress turns negative at −31.958 million. Four dispatch modes show that "deeper peak shaving is always better" does not hold.

Liaoning load-side VPP: skills/virtual-power-plant/instances/liaoning-vpp-2026-11/, 12 industrial users plus behind-the-meter storage, 18 MW downward / 8 MW upward, 129 DR hours and 360 valley-fill hours a year. The balanced portfolio gives VPP 2.9234 million CNY, members 3.8012 million and total 6.7247 million; DR-only maximises the total at 9.0531 million (VPP 2.6198); full-stack 1.9405 / 2.7084 / 4.6489; conservative 1.7300 / 3.4780 / 5.2080. The resource budget enforces DR + frequency + storage ≤ 18 MW, so the same MW is never sold twice; whenever the VPP-optimal and total-optimal strategies differ, the review names the conflict.

Inner Mongolia West renewable spot: skills/spot-bidding-quant/instances/mengxi-wind-spot-2026-11/, 200 MW wind, 96 points, 2026-11-18. Day-ahead average 193.35 CNY/MWh with 16 negative-price points in real time; the P50 declaration is 3,130 MWh with a scenario expectation of 599,123 CNY; actual available 3,225.9 / delivered 2,977.2 MWh, curtailment 248.7 MWh, capture 197.35, deviation 3.10% inside the ±5% band so assessment is zero, actual 580,749 CNY, delta −28,672, residual −2.55e−11; the two-settlement comparison gives 597,766 (+17,016 versus real-time-only). The curtailment break-even price is −49.59 CNY/MWh: a negative price does not mean curtail, because each curtailed MWh also loses about 50 CNY/MWh of CfD hedge.

V2G aggregation (Shenzhen): skills/virtual-power-plant/instances/shenzhen-v2g-2026-11/, 430 vehicles, 7.78 MW vehicle-charger capability, 7.31 MW after the transformer limit, 13.26 MWh daily energy and 1.81 h duration. Arbitrage 1.5622, DR 0.9229 and reserve 0.0682 million CNY; fixed cost 1.0190 million, owners 1.3553 million, VPP 0.1790 million and total 1.5343 million; arbitrage-only makes VPP −0.2379 million, DR-first 0.0275 million and full-stack 0.1065 million (assessment 0.0379 million). Revenue is driven by MW × callable hours, not by unit price; declared MW is not effective MW, and fixed costs sit entirely with the aggregator.

Documentation and entries: new instance-layer READMEs for carbon, EMS and renewables; expanded instance-layer READMEs for electricity trading (three packs), VPP (five packs, two schemas) and retail (three packs including multi-user direct); .gitignore covers the three new skills' out/; scripts/instance-packs.mjs and the homepage instance entry now name V2G, direct connection, carbon compliance, park EMS, renewable decisions and interprovincial portfolios; both READMEs, all nine skill-card summaries and 更新清单 §8/§9 are synchronised to 23 packs / 11 provinces / 9 skills.

Verification: build, --check, matrix --check, consistency, maintenance ledger, policy links, git diff --check, all nine Python self-tests, and per-pack --check-config plus --demo for all 23 packs pass; body text stays at 42,293 lines and the search index only gains the single instance-overview record.

Boundaries: all nine packs are configuration layers that neither place orders nor replace trading-centre settlement, dispatch certification, direct-connection compliance or verification conclusions; unverified capacity standards, spot sub-bands, mechanism-price batches and price parameters are left blank or marked grade D; real units, user ledgers, bills, contracts, metering and holdings stay local.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: instance-pack overview page, homepage entry and search coverage
items: Background: the 14 instance packs previously appeared only on six skill pages, in the "related skills" sidebar of 16 knowledge modules and in three TXT downloads; neither the homepage nor site search offered an entry, so readers could not discover the instance layer from the knowledge hub. This change makes it a visible layer alongside the knowledge modules.

New generated page: scripts/instance-packs.mjs scans skills/*/instances/*/instance.json, validates eight required meta fields and reads each README H1 and opening quote to generate knowledge/instances.html — 14 cards, 6 skill groups and 8 provinces. Each card carries province and source-grade badges, entity, market, rule version, data cutoff and directory, plus links to README / instance.json / run.py / the skill page. The page is generated, never hand-edited, rebuilt by node scripts/build-knowledge-html.mjs, and covered by --check and the Pages pre-deploy check.

Homepage entry: the hero button group gains "实例包", the hero stats gain a fifth item "14 实例包", and a full-width entry banner follows the nine skill cards. Counts in the button, banner and stats all come from the instance data rather than hand-written text.

Search coverage: search-index.js gains one instance record beyond the 101 knowledge modules, with body anchors pointing to #pack-<instance_id>. Queries such as "实例包", "山东光储" and "持仓" now hit the overview and jump to the matching card; category and type filters still apply to knowledge modules only.

Verification and boundaries: build, --check, matrix --check, consistency, maintenance ledger, policy links and git diff --check pass, as do all nine Python self-tests; public counts are unchanged (still 101 modules / 13 sections / 9 skills) because the overview is an auxiliary page, not a knowledge module; every instance demo is grade-D synthetic data and corresponds to no real entity.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: Shandong PV-plus-storage and Shandong coal medium/long-term hedge instance packs
items: Choice and division of labour: the two packs close the two largest remaining gaps. The PV-plus-storage entity answers "should midday PV be curtailed, stored or exported, and how much net position should be declared", reusing the spot engine and the EMS dispatch core and adding only net-position synthesis and a no-grid-charging constraint. The medium/long-term hedge pack answers "how annual and monthly contracts decompose into 96 points, whether the hedge ratio is adequate, and how much carry versus curve shape contributes", and is the first instance layer for electricity-trading-expert. Both packs are JSON and CSV edits only; every demo is grade-D synthetic data and corresponds to no real plant, unit or contract.

Shandong PV-plus-storage joint bidding: skills/spot-bidding-quant/instances/shandong-pv-storage-2026-11/, a 200 MW PV plant plus a 100 MW/200 MWh co-located battery registered as one entity. Five paired price/PV scenarios each run one DP, plus a reference run; the declared net position is the per-interval median net export. Demo: reference PV 720.3 MWh, charge 191.9 / discharge 168.9 MWh, declared net export 652.6 MWh (reference schedule 693.6), expected curtailment 50.9 MWh; reference net margin 131,348, expectation 129,021, CVaR10 72,990; T+1 actual 130,428, delta −1,083, residual −9.32e−12. Curtailment appears only in the sunniest scenarios 3/4/5 (3.7 / 49.0 / 91.5 MWh) because the 100 MW export limit sits below the PV peak — high PV and high prices must not be assumed together; fingerprint d634623504c5.

Shandong coal medium/long-term position and curve decomposition: skills/electricity-trading-expert/instances/shandong-thermal-hedge-2026-11/, a 600 MW coal CHP unit (grade D) with four CfDs (annual base, monthly peak, monthly off-peak and a ten-day anchored curve), 7,500 MWh/day at a weighted price of 375.35. The new tools/hedge.py decomposes period energy into 96 points (365/30/10 days), supports five curve shapes, and computes positions, hedge ratio, the carry/shape decomposition, a six-bucket P&L bridge and D-7~D-1 rolling rebalancing. Demo: forecast 8,800 MWh, hedge ratio 85.23%, net exposure +1,300; reference revenue 3,285,582, expectation 3,295,135, CVaR10 3,238,910; hedge value +102,568 = carry +145,611 + shape −43,043 (residual −1.22e−09), so positive carry does not imply value-adding hedging; rolling target 7,480 versus the 7,500 contract book (+20 lot gap); T+1 actual 3,240,926, delta −44,657, residual 2.33e−10, with output volume the largest bucket at −54,111; fingerprint f1e965abe40e.

Documentation and indexes: the electricity-trading CN/EN SKILL gains a runnable-slice pointer in §4.4, three formula rows in §12 (hedge ratio, hedge-value decomposition, rolling rebalance) and a tools/hedge.py row in §15.5; the spot CN/EN SKILL §13.6 and instance-layer README gain the PV-plus-storage row; a new skills/electricity-trading-expert/instances/README.md documents the instance schema, fill-in flow and data-safety boundary; both README skill tables and two skill-card summaries in scripts/knowledge.config.mjs are synchronised.

Self-tests and verification: the electricity-trading selftest.py gains sections I/J (shape and period decomposition, a six-bucket toy bridge, bad-configuration rejection, a broken rolling chain, exact run numbers and fingerprint, 279 assertions in total); the spot selftest.py gains the PV-plus-storage section; all nine Python self-tests pass.

Boundaries: no new knowledge modules, skills or sections (still 101 / 13 / 9); both packs are configuration layers that neither place orders nor replace trading-centre settlement or dispatch certification; peak/off-peak windows are contractual, not provincial time-of-use tariffs, and contract prices are checked only for plausibility; real contracts, units, metering and settlement data stay local.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: Shandong thermal, Jiangsu C&I storage and Guangdong standalone storage P0 packs
items: Choice and division of labour: the three P0 packs fill entity sides that were still missing — the first coal/CHP generation slice (Shandong: heat-constrained must-run and cost-based offers), the first C&I user plus behind-the-meter storage slice (Jiangsu: bill lines, three basic-charge methods and declaration optimisation), and a second standalone storage slice (Guangdong: spot plus frequency stacking with capacity revenue excluded). All three need JSON and CSV edits only: about 30 minutes to fill in and under a minute to run. Every demo is grade-D synthetic data and corresponds to no real unit, user or plant.

Shandong coal/CHP (heat-driven minimum output): skills/spot-bidding-quant/instances/shandong-thermal-2026-11/, a 350 MW extraction-condensing CHP unit (grade D): minimum technical output 35%, heat load 240 MW_th at a heat-to-power ratio of 1.6 → heat-driven minimum 150 MW, above the 35% floor. The offer has two blocks — must-run at the heat floor and an incremental block at variable cost 260 + 20 CNY/MWh; 20 MW of AGC reserve is deducted from the energy maximum, mileage price takes the Document 52 cap of 0.015 CNY/kW·mile with a coefficient cap of 2, and the capacity compensation standard is left blank pending verification. Demo: declared 5,369.3 MWh, frequency revenue 6,000 CNY/day; net margin at reference 296,155, scenario expectation 324,691, CVaR10 −96,515 (the heat floor still runs in low-price scenarios, so a negative margin is structural); T+1 actual 344,127, delta +47,972, residual 3.64e−11; the largest of the six bridge buckets is price effect +42,616; fingerprint 8c7f9b6f5c49.

Jiangsu C&I storage (bill and demand): skills/tariff-bill-optimization/instances/jiangsu-ci-storage-2026-11/, a 10 kV user with a 1,600 kVA transformer, 1,000 kW declared demand and 500 kW / 1,000 kWh behind-the-meter storage (grade D): 12 months × 96 points, monthly bills split into energy / transmission / system operation / fund / basic charge / power factor, the three basic-charge methods compared, the ex-post declaration bound D* = max(40% floor, A/1.05), and demand and time-of-use charges recomputed after shaving. Demo: annual bill 6.6391 → 6.5868 million with declaration optimisation → 6.4747 million with storage; declaration saving 52,255, storage saving 70,072, total 122,328; annual discharge 113.9 / charge 126.6 MWh, average shave 54.7 kW; at 900 CNY/kWh and 60 CNY/kW-yr opex, capex 900,000 and simple payback 12.84 years; fingerprint 4a210e513c99. Jiangsu provincial tariff parameters are not closed, so every period and price is a grade-D example and must be replaced as a whole table on deployment.

Guangdong standalone storage (spot + frequency): skills/storage-investment-operations/instances/guangdong-storage-2026-11/, 100 MW / 200 MWh with 180 MWh usable, RTE 0.88, 0.8 cycles/day and 20 MW reserved for frequency regulation: arbitrage and frequency are accounted separately, frequency gross revenue is capacity × capacity price × 24 h + mileage × mileage price × K, then stacked with arbitrage after a 5% haircut. The Guangdong standalone-storage capacity price is not yet closed and is explicitly excluded; the pack only reports the capacity revenue gap needed for NPV breakeven, so the 165 CNY/kW-yr coal capacity price is never misapplied to storage. Demo: arbitrage net 8.6335 million, frequency gross 6.1607 million (capacity 1.7009 + mileage 4.4598), stack net 15.3193 million, opex 4.5314 million, operating net 10.7879 million; capex 180 million, NPV@8% −87.6613 million, IRR −1.30%, payback unreachable, LCOS 906.5 CNY/MWh; capacity gap 13.2512 million ≈ 132.5 CNY/kW-yr; scenario CVaR80 8.8563 million; fingerprint 4be13b138b52.

Documentation and indexes: the spot CN/EN SKILL §13.6 and the instance-layer README gain the Shandong thermal row (six-bucket bridge), and the earlier "five-bucket" wording is corrected; the storage CN/EN SKILL §2.1 gains the Guangdong pointer, and the instance-layer README adds the Guangdong rule tables, frequency CSV format and acceptance row; the tariff CN/EN SKILL gains §8.8 on the Jiangsu C&I storage instance; the three skill-card summaries and both README skill tables are synchronised.

Self-tests and verification: the spot selftest.py gains a Shandong thermal section (150 MW heat floor, price bounds, mileage-price overrun and capacity-payment misconfiguration rejection); the tariff selftest.py gains section I (three methods, declaration bound, missing-source and over-declaration rejection, exact run numbers and fingerprint); the storage selftest.py gains section L (capacity revenue must be false / null, reserve-overrun rejection, exact run numbers and fingerprint); all nine Python self-tests pass.

Boundaries: no new knowledge modules, skills or sections (still 101 / 13 / 9); all three packs are configuration layers that neither place orders nor replace trading-centre settlement or dispatch certification; unverified capacity standards, Jiangsu tariff parameters and frequency parameters are left blank or marked grade D; real units, user ledgers, bills, contracts and metering data stay local.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: Anhui, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Gansu and Shanxi instance packs
items: Choice and division of labour: five vertical slices at once, covering three entity sides — storage assets (Anhui capacity price, Shanxi 5-minute spot), load aggregation (Shanghai 407 "1+5", Zhejiang VPP 2.0) and a renewable farm (Gansu 2027H1 wind mechanism price). All five need JSON and CSV edits only: about 30 minutes to fill in and under a minute to run. Every demo is grade-D synthetic data and corresponds to no real entity.

Anhui standalone storage (capacity price): skills/storage-investment-operations/instances/anhui-storage-2027/ follows Wan Fagai Price Document [2026] No. 526: CNY 165/kW-yr, 6 h denominator, effective 2027-01-01, 98% monthly availability, and full deduction after three misses in a calendar year (the stepped deduction formula is grade D pending). The chain is duration ladder → scenario arbitrage → availability assessment → 15-year cash flow → review. Demo (100 MW / 400 MWh): 2/4/6 h capacity charge 5.50 / 11.00 / 16.50 million CNY, assessment 23 / 47 / 70 thousand, NPV@8% 38.629 / 94.591 / 150.553 million, IRR 14.51% / 15.86% / 16.31%, LCOS 553.3 / 529.1 / 521.0 CNY/MWh; scenario expected annual net 41.474 million, CVaR80 40.410 million; fingerprint 1ea292c25eed. Spot limits and the stepped deduction ratio are unverified and left blank or grade D, never estimated.

Shanghai user-side VPP (407 "1+5"): skills/virtual-power-plant/instances/shanghai-vpp-2026-11/, five resource classes at 96 points; the 5-day baseline drops days outside ±25% of the mean; 150.0 MW theoretical → 135.45 MW after availability → 115.13 MW after the 85% coincidence factor, declared 92.1 MW at 80% (4.19% of the 2027 2.2 GW target); the reference scenario clears 80.0 MW / plans 76.0 MWh with 108,714 CNY margin, scenario expectation 88,057 and CVaR80 0; fingerprint 6ac0d5e814ad.

Zhejiang VPP 2.0 (Notice [2026] No. 7): skills/virtual-power-plant/instances/zhejiang-vpp2-2026-11/, three unit classes at ≥5 MW/≥1 h; positive compensation 800/1000/1200 and negative 300/350/380 CNY/MW; 70% effective response, 3:7 rating weights, readiness fee zeroed after three fast-type failures. Demo with 10 calls: gross 35,382, assessment 3,660, net response 31,722, fast-type readiness fee 10,200, platform and metering 7,000, monthly net 34,922 CNY; ratings generation B 87.57 / storage A 94.27 / load C 77.25 — the load unit failed three consecutive fast calls, scored 67.50 and lost its fee; the A/B/C spread is for demonstration; fingerprint 5ceaa246ace4.

Gansu wind (2027H1 mechanism price): skills/spot-bidding-quant/instances/gansu-wind-2027/, spot V3.2 with a 40–500 declaration and 40–650 clearing band, 2027H1 wind mechanism price 0.2440 CNY/kWh; the declaration takes the 35% quantile of five wind scenarios while pricing uses separate price scenarios, and the mechanism difference is recomputed on actual volume. Demo (200 MW): declared 2,442.0 MWh (95.52% of forecast) at the 40 floor; plan 552,046, expectation 569,378, CVaR80 406,856; actual 2,550.3 MWh, capture 306 CNY/MWh, fishing assessment 349, net 581,869, delta +29,822, residual 1.46e-11; the 7-bucket bridge shows the real cost is energy lost by low declarations in high-price hours (+32,264), and the mechanism is a two-way difference (top-up when low, refund when high); fingerprint c53f38d3aaa5.

Shanxi standalone storage (5-minute spot): skills/spot-bidding-quant/instances/shanxi-storage-2026-11/, 288 points / 5 minutes (since 2025-11); total band 0–1,500 CNY/MWh with thermal 0–800 and renewables 0–740, storage sub-bands unverified; spread bidding with discharge break-even 139.8 and charge break-even 526.1; reference spread 563.9 (policy threshold 280), plan 1.59 cycles / 637.9 MWh; reference 53,314, expectation 52,025, CVaR10 44,933; actual DA/RT 367/375, discharge 286.4 / charge 353.6 MWh, net 59,301, delta +5,987, residual −7.09e-11; quantity gap concentrated at 19:30–19:50 (planned 77.4 MW, actual 0); fuse stress (17:00–19:00 at 450 CNY/MWh) hits −32,999 with stressed net 26,302; capacity revenue is zero and the coal 165 CNY/kW-yr is not applied to storage; fingerprint a7fc6976c64e.

Shandong demo unit fix: shandong-storage-2026-11/make_demo.py compared a sum of per-point MW directly with an MWh cycle target, omitting the 0.25 h factor; actual throughput was understated fourfold and the target-cycle check was distorted. With dt_h = mtu_min / 60 and regenerated data, actual discharge is 250.5 / charge 309.5 MWh at 1.40 cycles; the run reports plan 124,506 → actual 107,926, delta −16,579, residual 0. The pack README and historical changelog entries now show 107,926 / −16,579.

Documentation and indexes: the spot CN/EN SKILL §13.6 expands to the Shandong / Gansu / Shanxi packs (96/15 and 288/5 granularities); the VPP CN/EN SKILL §13.1 expands to the Shanghai / Zhejiang / Jiangsu packs; the storage CN/EN SKILL §2.1 gains an Anhui pointer; a storage instance-layer instances/README.md is added, and the spot and VPP instance-layer READMEs and both root READMEs are synchronised; the three skill-card summaries in scripts/knowledge.config.mjs now list multiple packs.

Self-tests and verification: the spot selftest.py gains Gansu and Shanxi sections (Shanxi rejects a 96-point template, capacity payment tied to storage, and a 12 h fuse window); the VPP selftest.py gains Shanghai and Zhejiang sections; the storage selftest.py gains the Anhui section; all nine Python self-tests pass. Build, --check, matrix --check, consistency, maintenance ledger, policy links and git diff --check pass; body text stays at 42,293 lines and the search index at 3,593,740 bytes.

Boundaries: no new knowledge modules, skills or sections (still 101 / 13 / 9); all five packs are configuration layers that neither place orders nor replace trading-centre settlement or certification; unverified limits, storage sub-bands and capacity prices are left blank or marked grade D; real assets, user ledgers, contracts and metering data stay local.
