entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: storage, tariff and VPP core modules filled out
items: Storage investment decision layer: Storage investment and operations section 4 becomes "parameters, worked examples and sensitivity". It adds a full 100 MW/200 MWh investment case (CAPEX CNY 200.00m, annual revenue CNY 36.569m, after-tax cash flow CNY 27.010m, NPV@8% CNY 31.194m, IRR 10.47%, payback 7.40 years, LCOS 742.24/458.15 CNY/MWh, DSCR 1.53), revenue stacking with a three-dimensional occupancy table, degradation/warranty/augmentation cash-flow treatment, O&M plus fire and grid-compliance costs (0.3 MW auxiliary load, CNY 1.31m a year), a 10-scenario sensitivity table and two comparison cases at 5 MW/10 MWh and 20 MW/40 MWh. Every figure matches the storage skill.

Tariff calculation chain: China's current electricity-price policy and verification section 4 becomes "subjects, calculation chain and worked bill". It adds the total bill formula and subject table, the agency-purchase composition and monthly calculation chain, a two-part tariff example across three methods (1,600 kVA / 1,150 kW, the 105% overrun and 40% floor, the closed-form optimum D* = max(40% floor, A ÷ 1.05), monthly optimization saving CNY 128,975.24), power-factor adjustment (CNY 131,600 base, CNY 3,684.80 difference; the simplified two-band rule is marked illustrative), funds, surcharges and the system operation fee, a complete CNY 171,600 bill and a seven-parameter provincial matrix. Common errors grow to 16 rows.

New VPP core module: VPPs: aggregation, dispatch and business models (m-vpp-core, first note in the VPP section, 758 body lines). It covers resource inventory and A-D classification, capability arithmetic (a 12.25 MW theoretical pool derates to 9.31 MW at 0.8 simultaneity and 0.95 availability), a seven-step access process with a 12-province threshold table, cloud-edge control and the data link, market participation and revenue stacking, a 10 MW/20 MWh aggregation dispatch example, CBL and settlement sharing, six business models and a park VPP case (NPV CNY 6.899m, IRR ~18.0%, payback 4.49 years), a provincial map, a 12-step delivery checklist, 10 failure modes and 15 misconceptions. It states the four capacity calibers and that the national VPP management measure has not been issued.

Carbon compliance worked example: Carbon asset practice adds section 3.1, "gap + 5% CCER + CBAM". A 1.0 Mt emitter with 0.92 Mt free allocation has an 80 kt gap; using the full 5% CCER cap (50 kt x 86.51) plus 30 kt CEA x 94.94 gives CNY 7.1737m, or CNY 89.67/t of gap, with the rule that the break-even CCER price equals the CEA price. A synthetic steel-export CBAM case (10 kt x 0.60 tCO2/t x EUR 75.28 = EUR 451,680) and a "two separate ledgers" boundary table are included; all figures are grade D.

Foundation A/D annual data refresh: Power-system primer A adds a 2026 snapshot (total 4.13 TW, wind+solar 2.01 TW / 48.7%, solar 1.286 TW overtaking coal 1.285 TW in July 2026, 1.09m registered market entities, at least 11 provincial spot markets plus the southern region). Primer D updates the section-1 structure table, adds 1.36 TW new-type storage at end-2025, 915 utilisation hours in Jan-Sep 2026 and 470 VPP projects / 16.85 GW, corrects Doc. 357's date to 2025-04-11, and fixes the claim that wind+solar already exceed half of installed capacity.

Wiring and counts: the VPP section description in knowledge.config.mjs is rewritten, the book note and the demand-response note move to order 2 and 3 with cross-links, and the carbon and foundation descriptions now mention the new example and snapshot. README / README_EN, INDEX_EN, 更新清单 and 索引与口径 move to 46 modules / 16,745 body lines / 69 Markdown files with 46 reading pages. Build and consistency checks pass.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: new SCADA and power-monitoring data-link module
items: New module: SCADA and the power-monitoring data link (m-scada, fifth note in the storage section, 1,183 body lines). It is positioned as the data plane for VPP/EMS, not a dispatch text: the opening lays out a layered architecture from field devices through the station/edge gateway, production-control SCADA, safe-access zone and management-information VPP/EMS, plus a closed control loop of issue → authorise → interlock → execute → read back → audit.

Point tables and the four remotes: object model, minimum field set, scaling/units/deadbands, quality codes, double-point intermediate states and a point-table checklist; commands and setpoints require select-before-operate, timeout, acknowledgement and read-back.

Edge and cloud deployment forms: SCADA is a functional definition, not a location-based taxonomy; two new sections cover edge-side SCADA (station/device tier: low latency, island-mode operation, control execution) and cloud SCADA (centralised monitoring platform: cross-site visibility, long-term history, analytics and remote operations), with a responsibility/latency/retention/security-zone comparison and three cloud-edge rules, plus the caveat that "cloud SCADA" is not a standards term and a control-centre cloud must still sit in the production-control or safe-access zone.

Deployment engineering detail: the edge section adds hardware/software composition, station dual-network/ring and common-mode failures, the edge-computing boundary, storage and backfill sizing, seven anti-patterns and six acceptance drills; the cloud section adds a reference stack, ingestion and data-governance conventions, multi-tenancy and permissions, SLA and contract clauses, storage-cost sizing, seven anti-patterns, five selection scenarios and six failure drills.

Protocols and links: IEC 60870-5-104 (TCP 2404, ASDU, k/w, t0–t3, CP56Time2a), IEC 61850 (MMS/GOOSE/SV, SCL, control models), Modbus (RTU/TCP 502, registers, no timestamp/quality/authentication), MQTT (QoS, retained, LWT, TLS, application-level acknowledgement) and the boundaries with OPC UA, DL/T 476 and CIM; five protocol-gateway pitfalls.

Latency, time sync and data governance: sampling/reporting/storage cycles, P50/P95/P99 latency contract wording, BeiDou/GPS/PTP/IRIG-B/NTP accuracy and use, UTC vs local time and CP56Time2a, completeness/correctness/timeliness/availability, backfill buffer sizing, historian compression and retention, and data lineage.

Alarms, redundancy and security: alarm levels and flood suppression, alarm lifecycle, redundancy layers and common-mode failures, failover drills; security zones, the production-control / management-information / safe-access split, horizontal isolation and vertical authentication, VPP cloud-edge control boundaries, MLPS and CII requirements, and a pre-commissioning checklist under the 2024 No. 27 order (effective 2025-01-01, replacing the 2014 No. 14 order).

Interfaces and acceptance: data and control contracts with EMS/VPP, the boundary between SCADA and settlement metering (SCADA cannot replace gateway meters), reconciliation steps, joint-commissioning cases, P0/P1 acceptance checklists, 15 failure modes, a standards table and a glossary.

Links and wiring: NDRC No. 27 order page/PDF, NEA Q&A, GB/T 36572-2018, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850-8-1, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA and NIST SP 800-82 Rev.3 were checked link by link; the storage-section description and coverage in knowledge.config.mjs, the related arrays and body pointers of both EMS notes, README / README_EN, INDEX_EN and the update checklist now reflect 45 modules / 15,512 lines / 68 Markdown files; build and consistency checks pass.

entries.label: v1.9 maintenance: quotation calibres and formula review for the two new skills
items: Quotation calibre fixed: retail §10.1 labelled 0.46025 the "minimum quotation" while it already contained target profit. It is split into a break-even quotation 0.45025 (wholesale 0.41725 + deviation 0.00800 + opex 0.02500) and a target quotation 0.46025 (+0.01000 target profit); signing at 0.46 is 0.975 fen above break-even but 0.025 fen below target, a thin buffer. The v1.9 entry is corrected the same way.

Break-even and risk line separated: §4.3 previously subtracted the risk premium R from the break-even price, which is not a zero-profit condition. It now shows the cash break-even S* = (P − D − O − F − cL)/(1 − c) and a separate safety line S*_R that also deducts R for internal limits and credit; R is a buffer, not an incurred cost.

Deviation formula dimensions fixed: §6.2 previously wrote 2σφ(t/σ) with ratios, which returns a ratio rather than kWh. It now defines σ_F = σ × F and t_F = t × F, so the expectation is 2σ_Fφ(t_F/σ_F) = 2σFφ(t/σ) and the 95% quantile is max((zσ − t)F, 0).

Cost terms completed: §5.1 contribution and §5.2 portfolio net profit now include guarantee funding F; §7.1 defines retail-wholesale inversion against full cost (wholesale + deviation + opex + guarantee funding); new §4.6 lists the quotation calibres (tax, line loss, deviation, green power/certificates, capacity/demand, adjustment mechanism).

Linked-package floor example corrected: §10.8 previously said the 0.40 floor "only guarantees a price of at least 0.41", but 0.41 is above 0.40, so the floor is not triggered. It now states that 0.40 is a retail-price floor and is not triggered at the formula price of 0.41, adds a 70/30 weighted procurement-cost column, and shows the break-even retail price of 0.433; if the floor applies to the spot price, back it out from P = αS + a ≥ 0.433.

User-side calibres added: line loss and tax calibres (line loss is generally recovered inside the T&D price, not added again); §6.1 now marks the 0.5%/0.15% power-factor slopes as illustrative, not a provincial standard; §3.6/§9.1 defer filing windows, the 40% floor and dual feeders to provincial rules; §7.4 standardizes "retail-wholesale inversion" and cross-references retail §§7–9; §10.1 adds line loss and tax rows.

Tools and regression unchanged: no calculator was edited, so every number still reproduces from tools/*.py; all seven tool-bearing skills' self-tests pass, and build-knowledge-html.mjs --check and check-consistency.mjs pass (44 modules / 14,326 lines, 67 Markdown files).

entries.label: v1.9: new retail electricity sales and risk skill with zero-dependency calculators
items: Ninth skill: Retail Electricity Sales & Risk Expert (retail-electricity-risk), in Chinese and English. It sits on the retailer's side and answers "how to price a package, which customers to keep, how to procure wholesale, how to control deviation, how to prevent retail-wholesale inversion, and how guarantees and exit work"; it covers five package types, full-cost pricing, customer contribution, procurement coverage, deviation expectation and quantiles, performance guarantees, credit A–D, 5/8/10 settlement, exit and universal service. Chapter 1 states the division of labour with Electricity Trading, Spot Bidding Quant, Tariff & Bill Optimization, VPP and Storage.

Zero-dependency tools: tools/package.py prices fixed and market-linked packages, single-customer annual results and the break-even spot price; tools/portfolio.py computes portfolio net profit, customer contribution, spot stress and the break-even multiplier; tools/deviation.py computes out-of-band volume, the expectation 2σφ(t/σ) and the 95% quantile; tools/guarantee.py computes current and draft guarantees, funding cost and gaps; tools/curves.py generates synthetic customer curves, spot curves and TOU prices.

Examples aligned: procurement at 0.41725, a break-even quotation of 0.45025 and a target quotation of 0.46025; signed at 0.46 the annual net profit is 292,500.00; the three-customer portfolio earns revenue of 28,900,000.00, net profit of 1,885,000.00 and 0.0314167 per kWh; spot +20% gives 238,000.00, +30% turns to −585,500.00, and the break-even rise is 22.89%, while a single industrial contract breaks even at spot 0.49 (+7.10%); candidate customer D contributes −101,250.00 per year; deviation at σ=2%/4%/6% gives expected assessments of 105.17 / 2,191.79 / 5,074.41 and 95% quantiles of 0 / 4,259.78 / 10,139.68; for 3 billion kWh the current guarantee is 25 million CNY and draft coefficients 1/5/10 give 30 million / 150 million / 300 million CNY; a 10 million CNY gap costs 100,000.00 per year; with a linked floor of 0.40, spot at 0.40 loses 0.02300 and the break-even retail price is 0.433.

Self-test: tools/selftest.py covers groups A–H with 63 assertions — closed-form hand calculations, stress scenarios, the quantile model, guarantee calibres, the gap and determinism; CI runs it, so the seven tool-bearing skills now have seven self-test steps.

Wiring: README / README_EN, the hub's "nine supporting skills", the skill count in scripts/knowledge.config.mjs, the CN/EN number parity in scripts/check-consistency.mjs (47 new assertions) and the skill-linkage table in 更新清单.md all move to nine skills; every skill header is bumped to v1.9.

entries.label: v1.8: new user-side tariff and bill optimization skill with zero-dependency calculators
items: Eighth skill: User-Side Tariff & Bill Optimization Expert (tariff-bill-optimization), in Chinese and English. It answers "where the bill is expensive, capacity or demand for the basic charge, what declared value to file, which retail package is cheaper", covering two-part tariffs, the 105% overrun, the 40% floor, TOU and critical peaks, power-factor assessment, government funds, agency purchasing and market-linked packages. The boundary is explicit: it answers price choice, filing and bill review only; interval dispatch belongs to EMS.

Zero-dependency tools: tools/bill.py itemizes the bill and computes the three basic-charge methods; tools/demand.py gives the closed-form optimum D* = max(40% floor, A/1.05); tools/tariff.py validates period tables and shifts load; tools/retail.py compares fixed, TOU and market-linked packages; tools/curves.py generates grade-D synthetic load and prices.

Examples aligned: the bill totals 171,600.00 CNY at 0.858 CNY/kWh, with energy at 48.95%; the three monthly basic charges are 51,200.00 / 43,809.52 / 46,000.00, with contracted demand saving 7,390.48; annual figures are 614,400.00 / 500,304.76 / 525,320.00, and monthly optimization saves 128,975.24 over one peak-month declaration; power factor 0.85→0.92 differs by 3,684.80; annual retail costs are 4,021,613.10 / 4,509,570.56 / 3,681,791.55, with a market-linked break-even rise of 10.15%; shifting 1,600 kWh saves 1,200.00 per day, 438,000.00 per year.

Self-test: tools/selftest.py covers groups A–H with 51 assertions — itemized recomputation, closed-form declaration, annual optimization, power factor, period validation, shifting and package scenarios; CI runs it, so the six tool-bearing skills now have six self-test steps.

Wiring: README / README_EN, the hub's "eight supporting skills", the skill count in scripts/knowledge.config.mjs, the CN/EN number parity in scripts/check-consistency.mjs (34 new assertions) and the skill-linkage table in 更新清单.md all move to eight skills.

entries.label: v1.7: new EMS dispatch skill with a zero-dependency scheduling kernel
items: Seventh skill: EMS Dispatch Expert (ems-dispatch), in Chinese and English. It covers hour-by-hour dispatch modelling, PCC and BMS-derated capability, demand and capacity payments, reserve and deliverability, degradation cost, MPC rolling and islanded switching. Section 1 records why it stands alone instead of folding into the VPP skill: the object is dispatch not aggregation, the method is optimisation not rules, the storage skill already defers dispatch to the algorithm notes, and the VPP skill only sketches a technology stack.

Zero-dependency kernel: tools/dispatch.py solves the single-battery LP by forward dynamic programming on a uniform SOC grid; charge/discharge exclusion holds by construction, grid import and export split on the net-load sign, and the model covers PV curtailment, PCC limits, reserve power and energy margins, and cycle or free terminal SOC. Supporting modules: storage.py (AC-side energy, one-way efficiency, regulation and demand), market.py (capacity payment, regulation mileage, demand bill), microgrid.py (microgrid wrapper and islanded energy accounting) and curves.py (synthetic curves).

Examples aligned: every worked example in section 9 of both algorithm notes now comes from the tool and is mirrored in the skill. The storage station nets 91,352.24 CNY/year from valley charging and peak discharge, plus 15,068.49 CNY/year capacity payment, 106,420.74 in total; the user-side case is 8,414.11 CNY/day (4,414.11 energy + 4,000 daily demand share); the shared PCC case gives 14,148 / 9,648 CNY/year; available capability is 418.95 kW / 735.00 kWh / 1.7544 h; the microgrid baseline is 7,408.72 CNY/day and the optimised plan 6,525.12 (−883.59, −11.93%), with peak load down from 878.54 to 838.50 kW.

Sensitivity set: section 9.4 of the microgrid note gains five controlled comparisons — degradation, +20% storage, 900 kW import limit, +20% PV with a 500 kW export cap, and reserve energy enforced — at 6,617.72 / 6,350.61 / 6,519.97 / 5,996.19 / 6,663.52 CNY/day. It also quantifies that reserve power is sufficient while reserve energy falls 52.63 kWh short, and that an 840 kW demand cap costs 5.15 CNY/day in energy but saves 3,082.99 CNY/month.

Self-test: tools/selftest.py grows to nine groups A–I and 82 assertions covering analytic hand calculations, dispatch feasibility, islanded switching, determinism and the sensitivity figures above; CI runs it, so the five tool-bearing skills now have five self-test steps.

Wiring: README / README_EN, the hub's "seven supporting skills", the skill count in scripts/knowledge.config.mjs, the CN/EN number parity in scripts/check-consistency.mjs (36 new assertions) and the skill-linkage table in 更新清单.md all move to seven skills.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: market risk, credit and settlement module + HTML reading page
items: New knowledge note: market risk, credit and settlement 2026-11. It is an institutional module, answering "how risk is classified, how credit is scored, how much guarantee is required, how deviation is penalised, how settlement runs, and what happens to users when a retailer fails". Forecasting, bidding and VaR/CVaR stay with the quantitative bidding note; market products and trading strategy with Electricity Trading Expert; project economics with Storage Investment & Operations; VPP aggregation with Virtual Power Plant Expert.

Risk and credit: the 2026-09-30 risk-control draft has 7 chapters / 32 articles, with five internal risk types (unfair competition, contract default, abnormal prices, mechanism, other) and three external ones (supply-demand imbalance, technical-system failure, public opinion), graded major/general × emergency/non-emergency; the 2026-10 credit-evaluation draft sets A (85,100], B (70,85], C (40,70], D [0,40] or serious dishonesty, evaluated quarterly with dynamic adjustment, and C/D retailers face higher guarantee amounts and cannot use insurance for incremental business.

Guarantee and deviation: current Doc. 1595 takes the larger of "12-month wholesale purchases × CNY 0.008/kWh" and "2-month maximum purchases × CNY 0.05/kWh"; the 2026 retailer-measure draft changes this to expected annual retail energy × CNY 0.01/kWh × coefficient 1-10, minimum CNY 2 million, with daily mark-to-market and a 1/3/1 working-day notice/top-up/restore cycle. Deviation assessment has no national threshold; Art. 74 of Doc. 1656 gives the difference-settlement principle, while exemptions and penalty prices follow provincial rules.

Settlement and exit: Doc. 976 sets a unified 5th/8th/10th working-day clock (reconciliation version / official version / bill), a 15-working-day objection window and 5 working days to confirm, with retro-adjustment in the next cycle; no imbalance pool is allowed; disputes go through the market committee, price/regulatory mediation, then arbitration or litigation. The 2026 retailer draft adds automatic reduction of business locations, automatic deregistration, termination of unperformed contracts with the retailer bearing losses; the universal-service price moves from 1.5x/2x to the spot real-time price in the month of failure.

Retail-side risk: more than 400 retailers exited in the first seven months of 2026; in Guangdong 298 of 500 were loss-making, with first-half average margin of CNY 0.0039/kWh (grade C, media/trading-center figures); fixed time-of-use packages are withdrawing in about 11 provinces; low-price volume grabs, side contracts and offline rebates are red lines.

Indexes and HTML: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md (Docs 976/1656/1595 and the three 2026 drafts, credit grades, guarantee formulas, deviation and settlement clocks, watchlist and cross-skill boundary); the knowledge hub gains its 42nd module card and knowledge/html/电力市场风险、信用与结算-2026-11.html, with counts updated to 42 modules / 14,086 lines.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: demand response, V2G and flexible resources module + HTML reading page
items: New knowledge note: demand response, V2G and flexible resources 2026-11. It is a resource-side module, answering "which loads can be flexed, how a baseline is certified, how response volume is computed, how assessment and settlement deduct, and how V2G participates in markets". VPP aggregation, control and business models stay with Virtual Power Plant Expert; market rules and cost allocation with Electricity Trading Expert; project economics and battery-degradation cost with Storage Investment & Operations.

Institutional framework: Doc. 1283 (demand-side management) and Doc. 1261 (load management), both effective 2023-10-01 for five years; the DR capability target is 3%-5% of maximum load (≥5% where the peak-valley gap exceeds 40%); the orderly-use plan must cover ≥30% of historical maximum load, with six levels (I-VI) of 5% each; "shift first, avoid second, curtail last".

2026 operating picture: the national summer peak reached 1,557 GW, setting four records, with 6 regional and 20 provincial grids at records; 31 provincial grids did not start DR or orderly use (CEC, 2026-11-05, grade B); demand-side adjustment capability is >90 GW, 6.0%+ of peak load (B); the VPP fleet was 470 projects / 16.85 GW measured at end-2025 (A), with a 2026 industry figure of >530 / >18 GW (C).

Baseline, assessment and settlement: hooks into DL/T 2162-2020, GB/T 32127 and GB/T 37016; sets out the "5+3" averaging, 15-min sampling, 25%-200% trimming and 3-h pre-event correction process, plus a baseline-manipulation detection and dispute checklist; a 10 MW baseline / 2 MW for 2 h example decomposes effective response, compensation and penalties, showing that a 0.5 MW baseline error can overpay about CNY 3,000 (D).

Provincial rules (2026): Guangdong Doc. 233 replaces Doc. 356 — annual peak trade CNY 0-2,700/MWh, minimum 0.02 MW, VPP ≥5 MW / ≥1 h, coefficients 1.0/1.4/1.6; Jiangsu fast response pays CNY 15/kWh for direct control and CNY 10/kWh for self-control, with a first batch of 27 direct (6-15, average 13.17) and 314 self-control (5-10, average 9.94); Zhejiang offers CNY 1/kW-month plus CNY 2-3/kWh; 11 further provinces are tabulated (Guangzhou, Hainan, Fujian, Hebei, Anhui, Shandong, Sichuan, Hunan, Ningxia, Guizhou, Shanxi).

V2G: Doc. 241 names 9 pilot cities + 30 projects (some reports say 32 — flagged); Doc. 1721 targets tens-of-GW bidirectional flexibility by 2030; the "15th Five-Year Plan" targets 50 GW of aggregated adjustable charging by 2030 (2025 base 10 GW) and support for 110 million EVs; the "three-year doubling" plan targets 5,000 bidirectional facilities and 20 GWh of reverse discharge by 2027. Synthetic cases: a private car nets about CNY 2,870/yr with a break-even spread of 0.381 CNY/kWh; 50 buses net CNY 597,500/yr (D).

Indexes and HTML: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md (Docs 1283/1261/1721/241 and the three-year plan, baseline and response calibres, provincial compensation, V2G battery and watchlist); the knowledge hub gains its 41st module card and knowledge/html/需求响应、车网互动与灵活性资源-2026-11.html, with counts updated to 41 modules / 12,976 lines.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: quantitative bidding and trading risk module + HTML reading page
items: New knowledge note: quantitative bidding and trading risk 2026-11. It is an engineering module, answering "how a forecast becomes a bid, how the bid enters the system, how settlement is reconciled, where the loss came from, and how limits are set", without repeating forecasting or bidding algorithms. Algorithms stay with Spot Bidding Quant, market rules and settlement formulas with Electricity Trading Expert, storage investment with Storage Investment & Operations, and aggregation control with Virtual Power Plant Expert.

2026 rule versions: at least 11 provincial spot markets were formal by 2026-09-30, and the southern regional market went formal on 2026-10-24; the 2026-10-19 spot-rules draft is proposed for 2027-01-01, comments due 2026-11-18; the retailer measure draft is proposed for 2027-01-01 with a CNY 2 million minimum guarantee/insurance/cash; credit evaluation is A/B/C/D and quarterly.

Engineering loop: rule parameters → data contracts → probabilistic forecasts → bidding portfolio → backtest gate → risk limits → settlement reconciliation → PnL attribution, each layer with inputs, outputs, failure modes and acceptance criteria; "freeze the rule version before backtesting" is treated as a hard rule.

Risk and reconciliation: five limit families (VaR/CVaR, exposure/limit, guarantee occupancy, margin calls, liquidity); settlement differences split into meter, price, ancillary, assessment and other; attribution split into forecast, bid, execution, rule and residual, with a T+1 review template.

Synthetic examples (grade D): a 100 MW/400 MWh storage asset earns about CNY 105,500/day, CNY 34.81 million/yr, or CNY 344.7/MWh; a 1 TWh/yr retailer starts at 0.063 CNY/kWh and CNY 172,600/day, turns to −0.027 CNY/kWh when spot rises by 0.30, losing CNY 740,000 over 10 days; a CNY 0.80 million settlement gap and a CNY 0.19 million T+1 attribution gap are decomposed item by item.

Indexes and HTML: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md (spot/retailer/credit drafts, guarantee and VaR/CVaR calibres, watchlist and cross-skill boundary); the knowledge hub gains its 40th module card and knowledge/html/量化报价与交易风控-工程化-2026-11.html, with counts updated to 40 modules / 11,940 lines.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: storage technology routes, safety and grid-forming grid connection + HTML reading page
items: New knowledge note: storage technology routes, safety and grid-forming grid connection 2026-11. It answers "which technology route to choose, how to design safety, what grid-forming actually provides, and how to test and cost it"; it is a knowledge module, not a standalone skill. Project economics stay with Storage Investment & Operations, grid processes and tests with Renewable Project Development, ancillary-service settlement with Electricity Trading Expert, and EMS algorithms with the two EMS notes.

Scale and routes (2026-09): China's new-type storage reached 167 GW / 435 GWh (+63%), average duration 2.61 h, and Jan-Sep equivalent utilisation 915 h; the 2027 target is 180 GW with about CNY 250 billion of direct investment; lithium-ion accounts for over 96% of installed new-type storage; 2-4 h system prices commonly 0.45-0.60 CNY/Wh.

Route comparison: lithium-ion, sodium-ion, all-vanadium flow, compressed air, flywheel/supercapacitor, molten-salt thermal, gravity, hydrogen and pumped hydro are compared on duration, efficiency, cycle life, calendar life, cost, safety and application. A 100 MW/400 MWh LCOS illustration gives about 0.25-0.32 / 0.55-0.65 / 0.30-0.38 CNY/kWh for lithium, flow and compressed air respectively (grade D).

Safety: thermal-runaway mechanism and five lines of defence (cell, module, cabin, station, emergency); BMS/EMS/PCS/fire-system interlocks; suppression agents and their limits; standards GB 44240-2024 (mandatory, 2025-08-01), GB/T 51048-2025 (2026-04-01), GB/T 42288-2022, GB/T 46261-2025 (2026-09), GB/T 46957-2025 (2026-07-01) and T/CFPA 055-2026.

Grid-forming: current-source vs voltage-source, droop/VSG/VOC/DC-side control, inertia and RoCoF formulas, SCR, 3x current for 10 s, black start and multi-machine oscillation. Standards: GB/T 47968-2026 (effective 2026-11-01, 19 indicators) and GB/T 47655-2026 (effective 2027-02-01, first national standard defining grid-forming). 2025 grid-forming additions were about 7.3 GW/25.2 GWh (12.8% penetration); 2026 Q1 additions were 2.48 GW/6.89 GWh (19.2% of capacity), grade B with conflicting calibres flagged.

Corrections and boundaries: no public national document was found for the circulated "nationwide mandatory grid-forming from 2026-04-01" or the "30% penetration target", so both are marked grade C/unverified; GB 44240-2024 is titled "Safety requirements for lithium secondary cells and batteries for electrical energy storage systems", not "technical specification"; grid-forming PCS carries a 15%-30% premium and system-level incremental cost is commonly 10%-20% (grade D, wide dispersion).

Indexes and HTML: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md (Doc. 1144, storage-safety and grid-forming standards, capacity/duration/grid-forming calibres); the knowledge hub gains its 39th module card and knowledge/html/储能技术路线安全与构网型并网-2026-11.html, with counts updated to 39 modules / 10,876 lines.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: inter-provincial and cross-regional trading module + HTML reading page
items: New knowledge note: inter-provincial and cross-regional trading 2026-11. It answers "how is power sold from sending to receiving provinces, how are inter-provincial medium/long-term and spot markets organised, how do regional markets fit, how are transmission charges and losses computed, and how are transmission rights bought"; it is a knowledge module, not a standalone skill. Provincial bidding and settlement stay with Electricity Trading Expert, delivery corridors and mechanism prices with Renewable Project Development, cross-province arbitrage with Storage Investment & Operations, and aggregator participation with VPP Expert.

Market layers and scale: inter-provincial, regional, provincial and cross-operator markets are not four isolated markets. Jan-Sep 2026 inter-provincial trading was 1,303.7 TWh (+9.1%), of which medium/long-term 1,240.3 TWh (95.1%), spot 57.8 TWh (4.4%), green 57.5 TWh, and cross-operator 7.0 TWh; Beijing / Guangzhou trading centres handled 1,089.7 (+11.2%) / 214.1 (−0.6%) TWh.

2026 rule changes: Doc. 1656 took effect on 2026-03-01 and repealed Doc. 889 and the green-power chapter; Doc. 275 (2026-04) makes inter-provincial spot a physical market, requires coupling with provincial spot and bans hidden administrative barriers; State Council Doc. [2026] No. 4 sets 2030/2035 milestones and "unified quoting, joint trading"; Doc. 915 creates the cross-operator mechanism; Doc. 715 approves the southern regional market, formal on 2026-10-24; Doc. 734 starts the Yunxiao HVDC transmission-right pilot on 2026-06-01.

Prices and examples (grade D): 2027 special-project transmission charges are 0.81–8.36 fen/kWh, with sending-province charges capped at 3 fen/kWh in principle. Synthetic cases: at a 0.45 CNY/kWh receiving price, the Qinghai–Henan corridor leaves 0.323 at the sending end (premium 0.073), falling to 0.273 with a 50 CNY/MWh transmission right; the Hami–Zhengzhou corridor leaves only 0.302, or 0.252 with the right — barely viable. A right of 100 MW × 300 h × 50 CNY/MWh costs CNY 1.5 million and breaks even at a 0.05 CNY/kWh spread; a 100 GWh user with a 0.07 CNY/kWh spread saves CNY 6.5 million a year after a 5% deviation charge.

Indexes and HTML: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md (837/275/915/715/734, the special-project pricing method and the 2027 transmission-price table); the knowledge hub gains its 38th module card and knowledge/html/省间与跨区交易-2026-11.html, with counts updated to 38 modules / 10,136 lines and category 04 renamed "Spot and inter-provincial trading".

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: Grid-connection assessment and the "two detailed rules" knowledge module
items: New knowledge note: grid-connection assessment and the two detailed rules 2026-11. It answers "how does the two-rules assessment work, how are AGC/AVC/primary-frequency calculated, what can be exempted, and how much does it cost"; it is a knowledge module, not a standalone skill. Ancillary-service markets and settlement stay with Electricity Trading Expert, grid standards and tests with Renewable Project Development, and assessment deductions with Storage Investment & Operations.

Document system: the national layer is Doc. [2021] No. 60 (grid-connection operation management) and No. 61 (ancillary services), both dated 2021-12-21 and covering 35 kV and above; regional/provincial rules set the parameters; project documents (dispatch agreement, test reports, monthly settlement statements) set the boundary. The NEA published a draft revision on 2026-09-30 that would rename "assessment" to "management" and add force-majeure and first-of-a-kind relief — a draft, not current law.

Formulas and thresholds: AGC combines K1/K2/K3 into Kp (principle cap 2; component floors and caps commonly 0.1 and 2), with 60 s for thermal and 20 s for hydro; the southern region assesses daily on-grid energy × (1 − qualified rate) × 0.1%, and Shandong's 2026 storage rules use performance benchmarks K1/K2/K3 = 1.3/1.7/1.4. AVC tracks availability, adjustment qualification, reactive-call qualification and bus-voltage qualification, commonly 98%/96%/90% or 99%/99%; Anhui uses 0.03% per percentage point with a 0.5% per-item cap. Primary frequency follows GB/T 40595-2021 (dead zones by source type, roughly ±0.02-0.067 Hz; droop 2%-6%, recommended 5%; lag ≤1 s) and GB/T 30370-2013 (thermal ±0.033 Hz, droop 3%-6%, 75% in 15 s).

Penalties and exemptions: a 20-row penalty table (trigger, calibre, cap, grade) and six exemption categories (grid cause, force majeure, dispatch instruction, planned maintenance/test, unit state, policy pilot), plus seven non-exempt cases. Exemptions must be filed within the publication window with evidence; late or unsupported claims are treated as the plant's responsibility.

Falsifiable example (grade D): a synthetic 300 MW coal unit with 150,000 MWh monthly on-grid energy and a CNY 0.40/kWh assessment price incurs 2,437.5 MWh / CNY 975,000, or 1.63% of monthly revenue; primary frequency, dispatch discipline and forced outage together account for 92.3%, while per-point AGC is only 0.3%. Under the stricter southern 0.1%/0.1 pp version, primary frequency would cost CNY 6 million without the cap; the 0.5% cap cuts it to CNY 300,000 — a 20× difference. The qualified rate must rise to 99.9% to save CNY 240,000 a month; 90%→99% remains capped and saves nothing.

Indexes and updates: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md; records Shandong Doc. 52 (effective 2026-10-01), Central China Doc. 129, the southern-region 2024-12-18 revision, the 2026 North/East China drafts and the unverified Shanxi document number.

entries.label: v1.6 addendum: Integrated energy and zero-carbon parks knowledge module
items: New knowledge note: integrated energy and zero-carbon parks 2026-11. It answers "how does a park become zero-carbon, can green direct connection pay, how should source-grid-load-storage be sized"; it is a knowledge module, not a standalone skill, and points market rules, storage economics and carbon accounting back to the six skills.

Policy and thresholds: Doc. 910's eight tasks; Doc. 1082's first batch of 52 national zero-carbon parks; State Council Doc. [2026] No. 22's "15th Five-Year Plan" targets of about 100 national parks and 500 zero-carbon factories; Docs 650/688's self-use floors of ≥60% of available generation and ≥30% of total consumption (35% before 2030) and the ≤20% export cap; Doc. 1192's capacity/demand-based network charge, with no system backup fee or volumetric network charge on grid imports; Doc. 280's three levels of source-grid-load-storage integration; Doc. 1044's full GEC coverage.

Tariff mechanics: in Guangdong's Doc. 1848 formula, 730 hours is a conversion parameter, the average load factor is published by the province (Jilin publishes it by end-November each year), and the public-grid access capacity is the one variable the project controls; storage, load management and off-peak production all reduce capacity and therefore the network charge.

Falsifiable example: a synthetic park moves from an all-in 0.6756 CNY/kWh to 0.6130 CNY/kWh, saving CNY 18.7692 million a year; the break-even LCOE is about 0.267 CNY/kWh, above which direct connection loses to simply buying power; cutting curtailment from 28% to 10% raises the saving to CNY 35.2492 million; cutting access capacity from 63 MVA to 50 MVA saves CNY 30.282 million versus the original mode (an incremental CNY 11.5128 million versus the direct-connection base).

Indexes and corrections: wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md; records that the first batch is 52 (not 56), that the 100 projects / 34.10 GW and 99 projects / 34.05 GW figures differ by date, and that the 35% threshold has two official wordings.

entries.label: v1.6: Renewable Project Development & Grid Connection Expert
items: Sixth skill: Renewable Project Development & Grid Connection Expert (Chinese and English). Covers the eight development stages of centralized wind, utility-scale PV, offshore wind and distributed PV, answering "can the project be developed, can it connect, can it pass investment committee"; market rules and settlement stay in Electricity Trading Expert, price forecasting and bidding in Spot Bidding Quant, co-located storage economics in Storage Investment & Operations.

Zero-dependency reference implementation: skills/renewable-project-development/tools/ (resource / lcoe / mechanism / finance / selftest, standard library only). python tools/selftest.py asserts the worked examples: P90 2,153.93 h, wind capacity factor 27.40%, Weibull screening 27.92%, PV specific yield 1,407.12 kWh/kWp; LCOE 252.80/283.94/446.43 CNY/MWh; mechanism settlement CNY 67.7448 million; NPV CNY 5.963 million, IRR 8.18%, payback 9.55 years, DSCR 1.76; combined stress NPV −CNY 94.0485 million, IRR 5.28%.

2026-2027 facts and calibres: Doc. 136's 2025-06-01 existing/incremental cut-off and provincial auction results (Zhejiang 0.3816, Hunan 0.23-0.35, Fujian 0.16-0.39, Guangdong 0.20-0.40, Liaoning 0.18-0.30, Gansu 0.2440, grades B/C); Docs 1656/114/411/650 and State Council Office Doc. [2026] No. 4; GB/T 19963.1-2021, GB/T 19964-2024, GB 38755-2019, GB/T 40595-2021, GB/T 36547-2024.

Falsifiable conclusions: LCOE is not the bid floor — Example A has a pre-tax LCOE of 252.80 CNY/MWh, but the after-tax break-even mechanism price at an 8% hurdle is 294.85 CNY/MWh, about 42 CNY/MWh higher; moving the mechanism price from 0.30 to 0.244 CNY/kWh turns "just passing 8%" into NPV −CNY 58.931 million and IRR 6.15%; when resource, cost and capture price all turn unfavourable, IRR falls to 5.28%.

Maintenance and indexes: added 新能源项目开发与并网-2026-11; wired into both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md; version markers raised to v1.6, the checker now covers the sixth skill pair and renewable CN/EN numbers, and CI runs the renewable self-test.

entries.label: v1.5 addendum: China electricity-price knowledge module
items: Four new pricing notes: price history, price taxonomy, current policy and lookup and international comparison method. They form a knowledge layer — how prices got here, what a price is made of, which documents govern it today, and how to compare across countries — without repeating the market rules or bidding methods already in the skills.

History in five stages: 1949-1985 unified catalog prices and funded power construction; 1985-2002 operating-period pricing and rural grid reform; 2002-2015 benchmark prices, coal-electricity linkage, renewable benchmarks and residential tiers; 2015-2021 transmission-distribution pricing, spot pilots and Doc. 1439; 2021-2026 capacity pricing and Docs 136/411/1656/114. Each stage records who sets prices, in what form, how costs are recovered and what problems remain.

Taxonomy in three segments: generation, network (permitted revenue = permitted cost + reasonable return + taxes) and retail; capacity, ancillary and environmental prices; line losses, system operation fee, government funds, the two-part tariff and the 105% demand rule, with a synthetic bill (200 MWh at CNY 0.858/kWh), ten calibres and nine common errors.

Current policy by document number: a 14-document table (742/1583/500/1093/1439/809/1047/1217/1501/136/411/1656/114 and State Council Doc. 4 of 2026), the four 2026 threads (TOU reconstruction, capacity-price expansion, renewable mechanism prices, system costs), a four-step user-side lookup and a provincial sample table.

International comparison is method only: five harmonisation steps, a six-row component decomposition (energy / transmission / distribution / system services / taxes and levies / VAT) and a country-card YAML template; a synthetic A/B example shows a nominal ranking flipping under purchasing-power parity. Country data will be filled in later versions — no unverified ranking is published first.

Index wiring: entries added to both READMEs, knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md and knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md; pricing institutions and history belong to this module, market rules and settlement stay with Electricity Trading Expert, and project economics with the storage skill.

entries.label: v1.5
items: Fifth skill: Storage Investment & Operations Expert (Chinese and English). Covers independent/shared storage, renewable co-located storage, C&I behind-the-meter, thermal-plus-storage, microgrids and VPP aggregation; answers "is it worth investing in, how does revenue stack, how do assessments deduct". Market rules and settlement stay in Electricity Trading Expert; dispatch algorithms point to the two EMS notes under knowledge/.

Zero-dependency reference implementation: skills/storage-investment-operations/tools/ (stacking / finance / degradation / selftest, standard library only). python tools/selftest.py asserts the worked examples: independent storage annual net arbitrage CNY 31.069 million, capacity charge CNY 5.5 million, NPV CNY 31.194 million, IRR 10.47%, LCOS 742.24/458.15 CNY/MWh, DSCR 1.53; C&I IRR 12.59%, payback 5.52 years; co-located IRR 4.98%/0.26%.

2026-11 policy and cost facts: Doc. 114 capacity-price formula and Anhui CNY 165/kW-yr with a 6 h denominator (2/4/6 h → 1/3, 2/3, 1); Doc. 1656 removes government-set TOU, Zhejiang spread 0.83→0.50 CNY/kWh (−28.5%), Jiangsu 0.85→0.65 (−25%, grade C); Doc. 411 ancillary products; Doc. 136 excludes co-located storage from the capacity price; Docs 1583/500 set the 105% doubled-demand rule; 2026-09/10 tender ranges and GB/T 36549-2018 KPI calibres.

Falsifiable conclusions: the independent base case "passes but not by much" — with the capacity price at zero, NPV is −CNY 4.11 million; C&I demand savings are 51% of revenue, and without them payback extends to about 8.8 years; co-located storage is extremely sensitive to whether curtailment is free. Sensitivities show spread and cycle count matter most, while CAPEX and the capacity price decide whether the project clears the hurdle.

Maintenance and indexes: added 储能投资与运营-2026-11; wired into both READMEs, the bilingual index and the caliber handbook; version markers raised to v1.5, the checker now covers the fifth skill pair and storage CN/EN numbers, and CI runs the storage self-test.

entries.label: v1.4
items: Fourth skill: Carbon Asset Management Expert (Chinese and English). Covers compliance calendars, allowance gaps, CEA/CCER procurement, CCER development economics, carbon-finance instruments, carbon price scenarios, electricity-carbon accounting and CBAM. Scope is "how to comply, how to model, how to finance"; power-market rules stay in Electricity Trading Expert.

Zero-dependency reference implementation: skills/carbon-asset-expert/tools/ (compliance / ccer / finance / calendar_tool / selftest, standard library only). python tools/selftest.py asserts the worked examples: 8 Mt allocation, 0.6 Mt gap, CNY 54.453 million purchase cost, CNY 135 million five-fold penalty; CCER project NPV −CNY 3.095 million, IRR 6.25%, break-even CNY 89.61/t; pledge margin-call price CNY 71.25/t; seven compliance milestones exported as ICS.

2026-11 facts and corrections: 3,680 entities and about 8.3 billion tonnes covered; CCER offset cap 5%, 44 projects and an average CNY 86.51/t by mid-October 2026; CBAM effective 2026-01-01 but certificates purchased from 2027-02 and first surrender 2027-09-30; carbon futures not listed as of 2026-11; GEC prices by vintage 0.56/1.60/6.16 CNY.

Carbon skill extension (product and trade side): Ch. 11 is now "Product Carbon Footprint, CBAM and Green Trade", adding PCF boundary/allocation/factors (worked example 12.4 kg/kg, CNY 892.8 offset), ISO 14068:2026 neutrality claims, supply-chain carbon data, DPP / battery passport (2027-02-18) and cross-border carbon data; new §9.6 on carbon-data credit and §12.6 on data governance; the CCER cap is stated uniformly as "5% × verified emissions / surrender obligation".

Reference implementation updated: new pcf.py (life-cycle total, intensity, stage shares, co-product allocation, residual after reduction, offset cost), plus allocation_with_certification_bonus and carbon_linked_loan_savings; selftest.py asserts every new worked example.

Maintenance and division: added 碳资产实务-2026-11 and the carbon-management vendor research note; Electricity Trading Expert Ch. 10 keeps market rules and a carbon-price overview with a pointer to the new skill; version markers raised to v1.4, the checker now covers the fourth skill pair and carbon CN/EN numbers, and CI runs the carbon self-test.

entries.label: v1.3 addendum: Power System 101
items: Four new knowledge notes: landscape, fundamentals, reform history, new actors. They form a general-education layer — institutions, terminology and history for readers without a power-sector background — and deliberately carry no provincial rule parameters or bidding methods.

Three caliber warnings built into the text: no current installed-capacity share for the five majors (pointing to CLPIA instead); "four smalls" is a historical label and Guohua has merged into CHN Energy; any change in system operation fees must state province and month.

Index wiring: entry points in the skills section and structure trees of both READMEs, the file map in knowledge/INDEX_EN-2026-11.md, and one ownership rule in knowledge/索引与口径-2026-11.md, so general-education content is not duplicated inside the skills.

entries.label: v1.3
items: Third skill: Spot Bidding Quant (Chinese and English). Covers the data layer and leakage prevention, load/price/output forecasting, bias correction, quantity-price curves and declared-quantity decisions, retail procurement portfolios, bid simulation, rolling backtests and four-way T+1 attribution. Scope is "how to compute, how to bid, how to verify"; market rules and settlement stay in the Electricity Trading Expert, aggregation and operations in the Virtual Power Plant Expert.

Zero-dependency reference implementation plus synthetic data: skills/spot-bidding-quant/tools/ (forecast / bid / simulate / backtest / selftest, standard library only) and data/sample/synthetic_spot_60d.csv (60 days × 96 slots, generated with a fixed seed, not real market data). python tools/selftest.py asserts the figures quoted in the text, so prose and code cannot drift apart silently.

Falsifiable conclusions: the optimal bid of a price taker equals marginal cost (no markup is computed for price takers); pivotal units price on residual demand; the storage arbitrage threshold is cycle cost divided by efficiency (68.2 CNY/MWh in the sample); on the synthetic sample the corrected load forecast improves MAE by 10.8% over seasonal naive, and price direction accuracy is 61.4%.

Vendor material split by side and graded: participant side (Shanghai Lumin AI — all performance figures grade C, never benchmarks) and operations/rules side (Beijing Tsintergy — awarded the CNY 4.62 million "clearing-algorithm upgrades" package of the Southern Regional spot technical-support system in 2026-05, grade B tender notice). On this basis Chapter 10.4, "production clearing engine vs teaching simulation", explains how dropping any of SCUC/SCED/RUC/joint clearing/inter-regional ATC/capacity changes what a conclusion can claim.

Compliance boundaries: no regulatory-evasion bidding practices, no economic or capacity withholding playbooks, no collusion strategies; market-power content is for identification and self-checks only; simulation results must be labelled "mechanism demonstration, not a revenue forecast".

entries.label: v1.2

items: Electricity Trading Expert: the list of formally running spot markets was updated from seven provinces to at least 11 provincial markets plus the southern regional market; added the national unified market (State Council Doc. 4 of 2026), the 2026 spot-market rules draft, Doc. 114 and the independent-storage capacity price, the 2026–2027 No. 136 auction results, 2026 carbon price / allowance plan / regulation revision, the CBAM certificate-timing correction, green-certificate vintage spreads, retailer exits and wholesale-retail inversion, nuclear power entering the market, and China's power and carbon futures progress.

Virtual Power Plant Expert: separated the official tally (470 projects / 16.85 GW tested capability) from the 2026 media figure (120 GW of connected capacity); added the note that the national VPP management measure is not yet issued, GB/T 47241-2026 taking effect, 2026 provincial rules, green direct connection (100 projects / 34.10 GW), the impact of the 2026 spot rules on VPPs, the retail-side transmission constraint, and per-ISO Order 2222 compliance detail.

Corrections: 2025 medium/long-term turnover 4.81 → 6.3522 trillion kWh (old caliber noted), green power 0.27 → 0.3285 trillion kWh, PJM 329.17 USD/MW-day labeled as 2027/28 (not 2028/29), and CBAM "in force in 2026" is not the same as "buying certificates in 2026".
